articleTitle: Method for the Determination of a Quality-of-Transmission Estimator along the Lightpaths of Partially Transparent Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a method to determine an analytical expression of the transmission Q-factor along a lightpath in a transparent networl. We experimentally assess its accuracy on a SMF-based WDM transmission system at 10.7 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: GMPLS extensions to Encompass Shared Regenerators in Transparent Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: GMPLS signaling extensions are proposed to encompass the presence of shared regenerators in transparent optical networks without routing protocol modifications. Low blocking probability is obtained with just two transparent set up attempts before using regenerators.

articleTitle: Experimental assessment of frequency-dependent crosstalk penalty with different 43 Gb/s modulation formats
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally analyse the crosstalk penalty versus the frequency location of the crosstalk, show that the classical crosstalk curves can be wrong by more than 6 dB, and compare different formats and filters.

articleTitle: RWA for Mitigating Power Excursion Effects in EDFA-based all-Optical Metro Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Two novel Routing and Wavelength Assignment (RWA) policies are proposed for all-optical metro mesh networks. These RWA policies contribute to mitigate the excessive power excursions in network links without requiring additional network resources.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of singly-polarized and polarisation-multiplexed coherent transmission at 10Gbauds under linear impairments
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The tolerance to narrow filtering and PMD is measured with and without polarization multiplexing at 10Gbauds based on QPSK formaf. Only a limited penalty is induced by polarization multiplexing, despite doubling of the channel rate.

articleTitle: Investigation of single-channel nonlinear impairments on 40Gb/s coherent Polarization Division Multiplexed QPSK in dispersion-managed or digitally
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The nonlinear tolerance of 40Gb/s coherent POM-QPSK is investigated. Inline dispersion-managed systems show better performance than digitally post ocmpensated systems, and can be further improved by 1dB with digdal mitigation of nonlinear phase distortions.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Novel OFDM-A Based 10Gb/s PON Architecture
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper introduces a novel architecture for next generation Passive Optical Network (PON) based on the employment of OFDMA, with the first experimental demonstration of 10Gbps optical OFDMA transmission using Directly Modulated Laser (DML) in 2.5GHz channel bandwidth.

articleTitle: Tunable, Fourth-Order Silicon Microring-Resonator Add-Drop Filters
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate the first tunable, high-order channel add-drop filters based on silicon microring resonators. They meet rigorous, telecom-grade spectral requirements for microphotonic R-OADMs (reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexers). The design addresses 100GHz-spaced, 40GHz-wide channels over 16-32nm.

articleTitle: 80-Gbit/s InP DQPSK modulator with an n-p-i-n structure
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed an InP DQPSK modulator with a newly designed n-p-i-n structure. Operation at 80 Gbit/s was achieved with a low driving voltage of 3 Vpp. The chip size is only 7.5 mm x 1.3 mm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 4-bit Photonic Analog-to-digital Conversion Employing Self-frequency shift and SPM-induced Spectral Compression
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the photonic analog-to-digital conversion employing soliton self-frequency shift and SPM-induced spectral compression. From experimental results, we confirm that input 15-level analog signals are successfully converted into 4-bit digital signals.

articleTitle: Impact of Nonlinearities on Optical OFDM with Direct Detection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The impact of Kerr effect and modulator nonlinearity on optical OFDM transmission is studied for an uncompensated link of 8x80km of SSMF. Especially, the dependency on the number of OFDM subcarriers is considered.

articleTitle: Long-reach Access and Future Broadband Network economics
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Operator drivers for extending the reach of GPON and futureproofing GPON deployments by reserving wavelengths for future use will be discussed. Next generation PON options will be reviewed as will economic aspects.

articleTitle: Polarization Stabilizer for Polarization-Division Multiplexed Optical Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The effectiveness of a magneto-optic polarization stabilizer in demultiplexing two polarization-division multiplexed channels is experimentally demonstrated. Bit-error rate measures are presented for RZ-OOK modulation format at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Dynamic Bandwidth assignment for Multi-service access in long-reach GPON
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel, two-state bandwidth assignment MAC protocol is demonstrated to assign network resources in long-reach GPONs. Network modelling has displayed significant improvement in packet loss-rate and channel throughput in the presence of service level differentiation.

articleTitle: Experimental Equalization of Crosstalk in a 2 x 2 MIMO System Based on Mode Group Diversity Multiplexing in MMF Systems @ 10.7 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate experimentally a 2 x 2 MIMO system based on Mode Group Diversity Multiplexing over MMF. We show that the interference between co propagating signals is strongly reduced by using equalization.

articleTitle: Study of precise optical modulation using Mach-Zehnder interferometers for advanced modulation formats
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigated impact of parasitic phase modulation at Mach-Zehnder modulators on advanced modulation formats, such as quadrature-amplitude-modulation. Phase error due to imbalance in a modulator can be compensated by using an optical frequency-shift-keying modulator.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Capacity beyond Terabit per second for Transparent Optical Transport Network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We review the recent challenges facing high-capacity transport technologies with the goal of over Tbps capacity. Novel modulation formats, multiplexing schemes, and distributed amplification are described that show the feasibility of an over 10 Tbps optical transport system with the channel rate over 100 Gbps.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-Insulator Modulators for Next-Generation 100 Gbit/s-Ethernet
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Novel SOI modulator schemes with unprecedented electrical bandwidth and compactness are proposed and investigated. We find that 100 Gbit/s modulation at 3 V peak-to-peak voltage is possible with ultra-compact devices of less than 2 mm length.

articleTitle: Home Network based on CWDM Broadcast and Select technology
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a new scheme of multi-service home network based on single mode fibre, using CWDM technologies in association with a broadcast and select architecture. Results concerning the network dimensioning are reported.

articleTitle: Raman Gain Suppression in All-solid Photonic Bandgap Fiber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Raman gain suppression by the photonic bandgap structure in all-solid PBGF was proposed and demonstrated in order to apply it to the high power laser delivery without power depletion by Raman process in the fiber.

articleTitle: Simple, Robust, and Wide-Range Frequency Offset Monitor for Automatic Frequency Control in Digital Coherent Receivers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a simple, robust and +/-10 GHz range frequency offset monitor used for automatic local laser frequency control in optical digital coherent receiver. It can tolerate low OSNR, large distortion and unsynchronized clock.

articleTitle: Negative Brillouin Gain and its Application to Distributed Fiber Sensing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Negative Brillouin gain in single-mode fibers has been temporally obtained at the resonant frequency. This negative gain combined with positive gain makes it possible to achieve higher spatial resolution in distributed Brillouin-based fiber sensing.

articleTitle: Coherent Crosstalk-suppression in WDM Access Networks employing Reflective Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Dithering the bias current of a Reflective SOA can very effectively reduce coherent crosstalk, which can be a major limitation in WDM-PON performance using colourless RSOA-based ONUs. The power penalty was reduced from 5dB to 1dB.

articleTitle: Multi-Impairment Monitoring for Photonic Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: As optical networks become more complex, the need to monitor more than just channel wavelength, power and OSNR becomes compelling. In this paper we describe an asynchronous sampling technique that can measure multiple simultaneous impairments.

articleTitle: PMD Tolerant Direct-Detection Optical OFDM System
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show that PMD degrades the transmission performance of an optical OFDM system which is based on direct-detection and single side-band transmission. Maximum PMD tolerance can be achieved applying polarization diversity together with polarization control.

articleTitle: 1.25 Gbit/s Transmission over up to 100 m Standard 1 mm Step-Index Polymer Optical Fibre using FFE or DFE Equalisation schemes
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: 1.25 Gbit/s OOK-transmission over up to 100m SI-POF is demonstrated using digital symbol-spaced equalisers such as Feed-Forward-Equaliser (FFE) and Decision-Feedback-Equaliser (DFE).

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Fully Functional Optical Burst Switched Network with Application Layer Resource Reservation Capability
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate on-demand application layer resource reservation over a fully functional applicationaware OBS test-bed. This is achieved by hardware implementation and integration of application layer Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) and the OBS Just-In-Time (JIT) signaling.

articleTitle: All-Optical Flip-Flop and Digital Inverter Functions using a Monolithic Semiconductor Ring Laser
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: All-Optical digital functions are experimentally demonstrated using a monolithic semiconductor ring laser (SRL). The SRL can operate as Flip-Flop for digital memory applications, and as a digital inverter with potential for all-optical 2R regeneration.

articleTitle: All-optical 160 Gbit/s RZ data retiming system incorporating a pulse shaping fibre Bragg grating
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We characterize a 160Gbit/s retimer based on flat-topped pulses shaped using a superstructured fibre Bragg grating. The benefits of using shaped rather than conventional pulse forms in terms of timing jitter reduction are confirmed by bit-error-rate measurements.

articleTitle: 100 Mbit/s - Gbit/s - 10 Gbit/s and beyond, the use of POF in home networking and interconnection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Fast Ethernet SI-POF systems are on the way to mass production now. Complete installation sets are available e.g. by Siemens. But POF technology offers much higher potential. Data rates of 1 Gbps can be realized by the use of PMMA-GI-POF, but also by multi carrier transmission on SI-POF. Data rates of 10 Gbps and more (30 Gbps have been demonstrated) can be realized by PF-GI-POF or by parallel transmission over POF ribbons. This presentation will give an overview of the presently available technology, possible applications and the advantages of POF technology in comparison to glass fibers and copper cables. The biggest application at this time is the use of POF in car networks. An even bigger POF market can be exploited when applied in home networks and in interconnection solutions.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of 40 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Transceiver for High OSNR and PMD Tolerance under Fast Polarization Changes
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Full-band tunable, multi-rate (43 and 44.6 Gb/s) RZ-DQPSK transceiver with excellent balance of OSNR and PMD tolerances under fast (1.6 rad/ms) SOP change was realized and its manufacturability was confirmed through measurement on 100 modules.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Generation and Delivery of Independent Wired and Wireless Services in Radio-over-Fiber Systems Using a Single Modulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated a novel radio-over-fiber scheme to simultaneously provide 2.5-Gbit/s wireless and 10-Gbit/s wired data using only a single modulator. It was successfully transmitted over 20-km SMF- 28 with <1.5-dB power penalty for both services.

articleTitle: Coherent Demodulation of Optical Quadrature Duobinary Signal with Spectral Efficiency of 4 bit/s/Hz per Polarization
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate demodulation of a 20-Gbit/s optical quadrature duobinary signal using the digital coherent receiver. The spectral efficiency reaches 4 bit/s/Hz/polarization owing to the narrowband duobinarycoded signal and quadrature modulation.

articleTitle: Effect of PON Geographical Distribution on Monitoring by Optical Coding
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We derive the performance and critical design issues of optical-coding based centralized live PON monitoring technique allowing more than 512 clients. We consider PON geographical distribution models in our performance evaluation.

articleTitle: A Novel Multiplexed Optical Code Label Processing with Huge Number of Address Entry for Scalable Optical Packet Switched Network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate multiplexed optical-code-label processing, which enables to recognize multi labels per one packet on the same time and increase address entries. It cannot be done in electricity and other optical label processing.

articleTitle: Polarization-Multiplexed 2.8 Gbit/s Synchronous QPSK Transmission with Real-Time Digital Polarization Tracking
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper presents the implementation of an electronic polarization tracking algorithm which enables real-time polarization-multiplexed synchronous QPSK transmission with DFB lasers. The achieved BER at 2.8 Gbit/s is well below the FEC threshold.

articleTitle: Bandwidth-Efficient Optical Burst-Switched Networks based on Traffic Engineering in the Wavelength Domain and Delayed Burst Scheduling
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper shows that simple JET-based OBS networks can be designed to achieve high bandwidth utilisation efficiency by combining traffic engineering in the wavelength domain and delayed burst scheduling at the ingress nodes.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s: ETDM Generation and Long Haul Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We review the electronic generation and transmission of recently demonstrated serial transport technologies at 100 Gb/s, including binary, multi-level, and coherently detected polarization-multiplexed formats.

articleTitle: Advanced Modulation Techniques for Polymer Optical Fiber Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: POF is a very attractive medium for broadband in-house networks. An overview is given on recent progress in advanced modulation techniques for Gigabit-Ethernet transmission over POF as well as high-capacity radio-over-POF at high microwave frequencies.

articleTitle: Pilot-Carrier Based Linewidth-Tolerant 8PSK Self-homodyne using Only One Modulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Linewidth-tolerant 8PSK self-homodyne modulation/demodulation using a DFB-LD with a linewidth of 30 MHz and only one modulator, based on a polarization-multiplexed pilot-carrier technique at 10 Gsymbol/s and even at 1 Gsymbol/s were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multilayer VPN Capabilities in SINET3
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper describes the practical network design of an advanced hybrid network that accommodates a rich variety of packet and circuit services, especially the multilayer VPN and layer-1 BoD services.

articleTitle: All-optical Hilbert transformer for optical single-side-band modulation by using sampled fiber Bragg grating based optical transversal filter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The first implementation of an optical Hilbert transformer for optical single side-band modulation, by using sampled fiber Bragg grating, has been reported. The principle, design, and measured frequency/time responses have been shown.

articleTitle: 8x107 Gbit/s Serial Binary NRZ/VSB Transmission over 480 km SSMF with 1bit/s/Hz Spectral Efficiency and without Optical Equalizer
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate error free 8x107 Gbit/s DWDM serial binary NRZ VSB transmission over 480 km SSMF without using an optical equalizer. A spectral efficiency of 1bit/s/Hz is achieved.

articleTitle: How Deep should Fibre go into the Access Network?
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: Optical fibre access to the home provides the most powerful and future-proof solution for versatile broadband services delivery, in combination with flexible optical routing, wireless last links to the user, and converged optical in-building networks.

articleTitle: Ultra-Fast Automatic Gain Control Amplifier with Unique and Simple Transient Control
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have developed the ultra-fast automatic gain control amplifier that has a feedforward controlled EDFA and a feedback controlled high-speed VOA. Sub-microsecond response time for 9-dB input fluctuation at 20-dB total gain is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Low cost Multi Band-OFDM for remote modulation of colourless ONU in hybrid WDM/TDM-PON architecture
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate the use of OFDM for remote modulation of colourless ONU as a low cost solution for upstream transmission in a hybrid WDM/TDM-PON architecture. A comparison is performed between two potential solutions.

articleTitle: EDFA Dynamic Range Extension via Novel Digital Pump Drive
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Pump laser threshold, L-I curve nonlinearity, kink and roll-off limitations are overcome via novel digital EDFA control. Pump power consumption, dissipation and output power are improved by enabling operation above traditional kink current.

articleTitle: Fast measurement of local PMD with high spatial resolution using stimulated Brillouin scattering
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Local beat length with a 21.5cm spatial resolution is measured in one second along a single mode fibre using the polarisation dependence of stimulated Brillouin scattering, in a non-destructive and simple way.

articleTitle: Simultaneous all-optical 2R regeneration of 4x10 Gbit/s Wavelength Division Multiplexed channels
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical regeneration of four WDM channels in a single optical fibre by using polarization multiplexing in a bidirectional configuration. We observe no performance degradation arising from the presence of the multiple channels.

articleTitle: MLSE-EDC versus optical dispersion compensation in a single-channel SPM-limited 800 km link at 10 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate experimentally the effectiveness of MLSE-EDC for application with signals distorted by self-phase modulation, and compare the results with those obtained using a variety of optical dispersion compensation maps.

articleTitle: 10-Gb/s OFDM with conventional DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show that using RF-pilot tone phase noise compensation optical coherent 10-Gb/s OFDM (12.5 Gb/s before coding) can be realized with conventional DFB lasers.

articleTitle: Asynchronous optical performance monitoring of RZ-DQPSK signals using delay-tap sampling
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate optical performance monitoring of OSNR and chromatic dispersion in RZ-DQPSK signals using asynchronous delay-tap sampling. Our method provides precise qualitative estimation over a broad range of impairment levels and good degradation isolation.

articleTitle: Large Dynamic Range 32 x 32 Optimized non-blocking SOA based Switch for 2.56Tb/s Interconnect Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A practical non-blocking 32x32 SOA based switch is demonstrated at 80Gb/s per port with IPDR of >20dB. This switch uses an optimised design that requires only 3 SOA cascades whilst limiting the total SOA count.

articleTitle: A WDM-PON Architecture with Selective-Broadcast Overlay
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel WDM-PON architecture supporting both point-to-point service and selective broadcasting. For each WDM channel, the same light source is utilized to carry the two downstream services and the upstream re-modulated data.

articleTitle: Novel Scheme for High-Bit-Rate Coherent-OFDM Transmission without PLL
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel architecture based on OFDM modulation and optical heterodyne detection that requires no electrical or optical phase-locked-loop is proposed. System performances are compared with those of a DQPSK system at a data-rate of 100-Gb/s.

articleTitle: A Parallel Equalizer for High-Speed Electronic Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A parallel architecture for linear transversal feed-forward (FFE) and decision feedback equalizers (DFE) is derived and applied to electronic dispersion compensation of a 40 Gbit/s intensity modulated optical transmission system with direct detection (IM/DD).

articleTitle: A 10.3125-Gbit/s SiGe BiCMOS Burst-Mode Clock and Data Recovery Circuit with 160-bit Consecutive Identical Digit Tolerance
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A burst-mode clock and data recovery (CDR) circuit for 10 G-EPON OLT receivers is presented. The CDR employs a single-VCO architecutre, which increases consecutive identical digit (CID) tolerance. The developed CDR demonstrates 160-bit CID tolerance.

articleTitle: Multistage Interconnection Network Photonic Controller Exploiting a Cascaded SOA-based Ultrafast Module
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In this paper we exploit cascades of a single SOA-based module working up to 160Gb/s to perform alloptical control and switching operations in a multistage Batcher-Banyan photonic interconnection network with intermediate contention manager.

articleTitle: Robust Detection of 10.7-Gb/s DPSK Using Joint Decision Maximum Likelihood Sequence Estimation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally apply Joint-Decision MLSE (JD-MLSE) detection to 10.7-Gbit/s DPSK. We demonstrate that a JD-MLSE using the constructive and destructive components preserves the 3-dB OSNR advantage of DPSK over OOK in dispersion-limited optical systems.

articleTitle: Low-Loss Dispersion-Shifted Solid-Core Photonic Bandgap Bragg Fiber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A Bragg fiber with the zero dispersion wavelength shifted towards 1mm has been proposed, fabricated and studied. Dispersion of 60 ps/(nmkm) has been achieved at 1064 nm with an optical loss of 1.1 dB/m.

articleTitle: 40Gb/s configurable photonic logic gates with XNOR, AND, NOR, OR and NOT functions employing a single SOA
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present 40Gb/s configurable photonic logic gates with XNOR, AND, NOR, OR, and NOT functions based on FWM, XGM and T-XPM in single SOA. A detuning filter is employed to enhance the SOA modulation bandwidth.

articleTitle: Waveband Selective Switch Using Concatenated AWGs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel waveband-selective switch. The switch makes the best use of the waveband multi/demultiplexers that can be created by connecting concatenated Planar Lightwave Circuit AWGs and switches. Its performance is successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Millimeter Resolution Reflectometry Over Two Kilometers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Millimeter resolution optical frequency domain reflectometry measurements are achieved over 2 km of length. This level of spatial resolution over kilometer distances enables unprecedented link characterization in emerging short-haul applications such as avionics and FTTx.

articleTitle: A Photonic Interconnect Layer on CMOS
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a photonic interconnect layer consisting of heterogeneous microdisk lasers and microdetectors integrated with a nanophotonic silicon waveguide circuit. The photonic layer is fabricated using waferscale processes and a die-to-wafer molecular bonding process.

articleTitle: Very high bit rates WDM transmission on a Transparent FSO System
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report experiments on a fully transparent WDM-FSO system. Results demonstrate that this kind of system is able to bring the high bandwidth of the fiber in the last mile/last hundred of meters scenario.

articleTitle: High Temperature, Colourless Operation of a Reflective Semiconductor Optical Amplifier for 2.5Gbit/s upstream transmission in a WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Wide temperature range operation of a reflective SOA as a high-speed, colourless upstream modulator is demonstrated in a WDM-PON architecture. 2.5Gbit/s upstream transmission over 10km up to 80deg C is shown across the C-band.

articleTitle: 1,200 km SMF (100 km spans) 280 Gbit/s Coherent WDM Transmission using Hybrid Raman/EDFA Amplification
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report the worlds first transmission of a 280Gbit/s Coherent WDM (261Gbit/s capacity) signal, over 1200km with 100km spans of SMF, a pattern length of 231-1, and with hybrid Raman/EDFA amplification.

articleTitle: Power Budget Improvement for Passive Outside Plant Long Reach High Density Access Network using High Bit Rate RSOA-ONUs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: New Remote Nodes design of Sardana network allows reaching >1000 ONUs along protected 100km and broadband to users by using thin-film filters, remote amplification, 1.25/2.5/5Gbps-capable RSOA-ONUs and 10Gbps down-stream.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient OFDM-Transmission with Compatible Single-Sideband Modulation for Direct Detection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: OFDM is suggested to overcome chromatic dispersion without explicit compensation. The use of the required single-sideband modulation in combination with direct detection calls for advanced modulation techniques. An old idea is observed and discussed.

articleTitle: Chirp reduction in quantum dot-like semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The chirp induced by saturated quantum dot SOA is carefully studied. It is demonstrated that circular dots allow for 50 km of transmission at 10 Gb/s, even upon saturation.

articleTitle: The WONDER Testbed: Architecture and Experimental Demonstration
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present the latest experimental results within the WONDER project, aiming at the demonstration of an advanced packet-based WDM architecture that recently reached its full maturity. Our results show the feasibility of all-optical networking using commercially available optoelectronic components.

articleTitle: Experimental Generation of FCC-Compliant UWB Pulse using FBGs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A simple and robust technique for the generation of power-efficient, FCC-compliant UWB pulses is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. An FBG shapes the source spectrum and a length of SMF performs the frequency-to-time conversion.

articleTitle: Broadband Swept Optical Single-sideband Modulation Generation for Spectral Characterization of Optical Components
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a technique for broadband optical single-sideband modulation generation for spectral measurement applications. We experimentally demonstrate an unwanted-sideband suppression over 35 dB in a broadband range from 50 MHz to 20 GHz.

articleTitle: High modulation bandwidth reflective SOA for optical access networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have demonstrated that the use of a two electrodes configuration drastically improves the modulation bandwidth of Reflective SOA from 2 to 6 GHz.

articleTitle: Chirp-Managed 42.8 Gbit/s Transmission over 20 km Standard SMF without DCF Using Directly Modulated Laser
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate transmission at 42.8 Gbit/s over 20 km of standard single mode fiber at 1550 nm with BER smaller than 1x10-3 without dispersion compensation using a directly modulated chirp managed laser.

articleTitle: Performance Improvements of Different Modulation Formats by Applying Adaptive Electronic Equalisation in 43 Gbit/s Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The system tolerance improvements by analog electronic equalisation have been experimentally evaluated for different 43 Gbit/s modulation formats (OOK, DPSK, PSBT). Up to 70% higher DGD and 60% higher CD tolerance has been achieved.

articleTitle: Optical Add-Drop Multiplexer Based on Fiber Optic Parametric Amplification
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a novel ultrafast FOPA-based all-optical add-drop TDM multiplexer. Both the drop and add functions were successfully evaluated with NRZ data at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Multi-domain routing techniques in ASON networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A pan-European ASON network has been simulated under dynamic traffic to compare the different multi-domain routing procedures allowed by the ASON Recommendations. Compared features are: network performance (blocking probability) and scalability (amount of required routing-information).

articleTitle: Uncompensated WDM transmission of 10.7 Gbit/s directly detected DPSK over 300 km standard single-mode fibre and through 6 SOAs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate uncompensated WDM transmission of 10.7 Gb/s DPSK signals demodulated with a narrowband optical filter in the receiver over 300 km of standard single-mode fibre and through 6 SOAs using an MLSE-EDC receiver.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Interworking GMPLS with OBS Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Dynamic interworking operation between GMPLS and OBS networks was successfully demonstrated for the first time by GMPLS extensions of a group-LSP and node capability advertisement. Data burst transmission over the create group-LSP was also verified.

articleTitle: Transmission of 1.25 Gb/s per Channel over 4.4 km Silica Multimode Fibre Using QAM Subcarrier Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: By applying 16-, 32- and 64-QAM subcarrier modulation, 1.25 Gb/s transmission per channel via a 4.4 km silica multimode fibre was experimentally demonstrated. The passband region of the fibre was deployed by the subcarrier channel.

articleTitle: Bi-directional unrepeatered transmission over 436 km using third-order distributed Raman amplification
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An error-free transmission experiment in bidirectional unrepeatered configuration over 436 km is reported. Particular attention has been paid to Rayleigh backscattering and distributed Raman amplification, enabling us to cover 77 dB span loss.

articleTitle: Simplified Base Station Configuration for Fiber-Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a technique to simplify base-station design using a VCSEL as an integrated reflector and transmitter for fiber-radio application. Results show IF-over fiber channels can be successful reflected and added at the base-station.

articleTitle: 80-Gb/s 256-QAM Signals using Phase Noise and DGD-Tolerant Pilot-Carrier-Aided Homodyne Detection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigated DGD tolerance enhancement for 80-Gb/s signals up to 20 ps by employing pilot-carrieraided self-homodyne detection with 10-Gsymbol/s 256-QAM, instead of 40-Gsymbol/s DQPSK, without using a narrow spectral linewidth light source.

articleTitle: 70 x 10 Gbps (mixed RZ-OOK and RZ-DPSK) upgrade of a 7224 km conventional 32 x 10 Gbps designed system
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: NZDSF link designed for 32 x 10 Gbps CRZ capacity by using a mix of 24 OOK-RZ and 46 RZ-DPSK 10 Gbps channels.

articleTitle: Multi-Frequency Heterodyne System for All-Optical-Technology-Free Ultrafast Optical Waveform Measurement
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A multi-frequency heterodyne system for ultrafast optical waveform measurement is demonstrated. Ultrafast waveform beyond photodiode bandwidth is downconverted to a slow-speed signal by photomixing with a locally generated ultra-flat comb. 80-GHz waveform was successfully measured.

articleTitle: The Memory of Optimized Dispersion-Managed Periodic Optical Links
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We provide a new expression of the pseudo-random sequence length needed for reliable testing of DM periodic optical links with optimized pre- and post-compensation, and show that it scales linearly with bitrate.

articleTitle: All-optical Data Processing Using Directional Monostability in Semiconductor Ring Laser
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper describes all-optical data processing characteristics of an optical digital device based on the directional optical bistability and monstability in semiconductor ring laser. Experimental demonstration of alloptical monostable and data gating operations is reported.

articleTitle: Carrier phase estimation for coherent equalization of 43-Gb/s POLMUXNRZ- DQPSK transmission with 10.7-Gb/s NRZ neighbours
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show the influence of 10.7-Gb/s NRZ neighbors on 43-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed NRZ-DQPSK transmission combined with digital coherent equalization. The impact of XPM induced phase noise is reduced with an optimized carrier phase estimation (CPE) algorithm.

articleTitle: DSP-Enhanced Differential Direct-Detection for DQPSK and m-ary DPSK
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We review the principle and progress of sampled self-coherent optical receiver based on differentialdirect- detection and digital-signal-processing, showing promise of improving receiver sensitivity, receiving multilevel DPSK formats, reconstructing signal field, and digital compensation of transmission impairments.

articleTitle: Digital Coherent Receivers for Uncompensated 42.8Gbit/s Transmission over High PMD Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We outline the principles behind digital coherent receivers and report simultaneous compensation of 53,712ps/nm chromatic dispersion from 3200km of SMF and a mean DGD up to 186ps using 42.8Gbit/s PDMQPSK with a digital coherent receiver.

articleTitle: Slow Light Waveguide Detector Slowing Light in Bragg Reflector Waveguide
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated a slow-light waveguide detector, slowing light in a Bragg reflector waveguide. The length of the detector is as small as 20micrometer. A possibility of size-reduction and polarization-insensitive operations is presented.

articleTitle: High-Power 10-Gb/s Semi-Cooled Operation of AlGaInAs Electroabsorption Modulator Integrated lambda/4-Shifted DFB Laser
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: High-power 10-Gb/s semi-cooled operation was attained for AlGaInAs electroabsorption modulator integrated AlGaInAs lambda/4-shifted DFB lasers. At 53 deg C, a 9.95-Gb/s 100-km transmission was achieved with an average fiber output power of +3.0 dBm.

articleTitle: Polarization Independent All-Optical 3R Regeneration of Optical Packets Based on the Kerr Effect and Offset Spectral Slicing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Polarization independent all-optical 3R packet regeneration is demonstrated at 10 Gb/s. With careful design, a remarkable property of cross-phase modulation yields excellent performance with no additional complexity compared to an implementation that requires polarization control.

articleTitle: Performance of MLSE in Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show the improvements maximum likelihood sequence estimation (MLSE) brings for different transmission impairments in optical transmission systems. We consider MLSEs with 4 states and 16 states and show the impact of other parameter choices.

articleTitle: 10 GHz Balanced Photodetector with +17 dBm RF Output Power
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on a novel high-power balanced photodetector with 0.75 A/W responsivity and 870 mA-GHz saturation current-bandwidth product. The common mode rejection ratio is >30 dB.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s Optical Buffer Memory Using a Polarization Bistable VCSEL
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Optical buffer memory was experimentally demonstrated at 10 Gb/s using a polarization bistable verticalcavity surface-emitting laser. Fast switching operation was obtained by increasing the detuning frequency between the injection light and the lasing output.

articleTitle: DWDM Achieved with Thermal Sources: a Future-proof PON Solution
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We achieve the promise of semiconductor amplifiers (SOAs) to mitigate severe intensity noise of spectrum-sliced WDM, notwithstanding optical filtering at the receiver. Dense WDM capacity is demonstrated using a thermal source and a saturated SOA.

articleTitle: Small Helical Reflective Arrayed-Waveguide Grating with Integrated Loop Mirrors
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have fabricated a 25-GHz-spacing, 8-ch, compact helical reflective arrayed-waveguide grating with integrated loop mirrors. The loss, the polarization dependent loss, and the adjacent-channel crosstalk were 10.9 dB, 0.1 dB, and -8.2 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Stimulated Brillouin amplification in a tellurite fiber as a potential system for slow light generation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated stimulated Brillouin amplification in a single mode non-doped tellurite fiber. Potential performance of a tellurite fiber for slow light generation is clarified on the base of Brillouin gain characteristics.

articleTitle: In-service measurement of the OSNR in ROADM-based Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Optical networks using ROADMs present a challenge for OSNR testing. We propose a new method for measuring the in-band OSNR based on a high resolution optical spectrum analyzer using a new optical polarization splitting method.

articleTitle: Nonreciprocal Microdisk Resonators Utilizing Magnetic Bubble Domains in Garnet Film for Ultra-Compact Optical Waveguide Isolators
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The three-dimensional characteristics of magneto-optical microresonators are presented, leading to a guideline for the design of nonreciprocal circuits. This involves a demonstration of how the resonators with selected parameters are practical for miniaturized nonreciprocal circuits.

articleTitle: Phase-Preserving 2R-Regeneration of an 80-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Signal by Using a Nonlinear Amplifying Loop Mirror
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The performance of a nonlinear amplifying loop mirror as a 2R regenerator for an 80-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK has been investigated. A significant eye-opening improvement and a negative power penalty of 2.6 dB have been obtained.

articleTitle: Hybrid III-V and IV lasers and amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Silicon evanescent lasers and amplifiers have been demonstrated utilizing low temperature wafer bonding technology. This approach enables the creation of high performance, small footprint active devices on silicon for photonic integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Optimized Superimposed Fiber Bragg Gratings to Reduce Birefringence Effects in WDM Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the reduction of Differential Group Delay and Polarization Dependent Loss in Superimposed Fiber Bragg Gratings when the fiber is rotated after each inscription, which is of great importance in WDM applications.

articleTitle: Sub-pJ and simultaneous multiple wavelength switching of an all-optical flip-flop based on a DFB-LD with integrated SOA
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Sub-pJ switching of a SOA and DFB laser diode based all-optical flip-flop is presented. Simultaneous switching of multiple wavelengths is demonstrated with switch times as low as 100ps and an ER over 15dB.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Phase Noise Separation Method for Simulation of ASK Optical Fibre Transmission Systems with Strong Signal-Noise Interaction
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a method that enables accurate ASK system modelling even when the detected optical field obeys non-Gaussian statistics with a substantial amount of nonlinear phase noise accumulated in the fibre due to signal-noise interaction.

articleTitle: A Highly Stable Evanescently-Coupled Hybrid Fibre Semiconductor Laser Design
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present an evanescent coupling method between a semiconductor anti-resonant reflecting optical waveguide and a side-polished fibre. In particular, we have been able to demonstrate the first hybrid evanescently-coupled fibre semiconductor laser using this technology.

articleTitle: FTTC: The concept for implementing Broadband Access and the experience of Deutsche Telekom
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In 2006 Deutsche Telekom initiated a full scale roll-out of VDSL-based broadband access technology providing the coverage of about 8 Mio. Customers with very high speed internet accesses by end of the year. Motivation, realization and practical experiences will be discussed.

articleTitle: Square Lattice Hollow Core Photonic Bandgap Fibres
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel photonic bandgap fibre (PBGF) based on a square lattice cladding. The fibre presents a 20% wider bandgap than conventional triangular-lattice-based PBGFs and with a 9-cell core can be effectively single moded.

articleTitle: Transient Behaviour of Nonlinear Optical Compensator Based on Vertical Micro-Cavity Saturable Absorber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated the 25 ps transient response of a nonlinear-effect compensator based on a reversebiased vertical cavity saturable absorber. The modelling and experiment on the transient behaviour of negative nonlinear phase-shift are presented.

articleTitle: High Efficiency and High Output Power Fiber Optic Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a nearly complete depletion of 99.92% and a high power conversion efficiency with a signal output power of 0.53 W in a fiber optic parametric amplifier with a pump power of 1 W.

articleTitle: Optimization of SBS-Suppression for 320 Gbit/s DQPSK All-Optical Wavelength Conversion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate single- and dual-tone phase modulation of the cw-pump for effective stimulated Brillouin scattering suppression in all-optical wavelength conversion based on FWM in highly-nonlinear fibre. The performance is evaluated in 320 Gbit/s DQPSK wavelength conversion experiments.

articleTitle: Low Noise Fiber Raman Amplifiers using a Raman Ring Fiber Oscillator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose two fiber Raman amplifier schemes based on Raman ring fiber oscillator to reduce double Rayleigh scattering noise at high gains and successfully demonstrate their low noise characteristics by measuring bit-error-rate data at 10Gb/s.

articleTitle: Spontaneous Brillouin Scattering Modelling and Measurement in Various Axisymetric Optical Fibres
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We describe a computation method of spontaneous Brillouin scattering process using a simple original acoustic mode analysis. Numerical results have been compared with measured Brillouin spectra for two different commercially available fibres.

articleTitle: Nano-Crystallized Glass Fibers with Second-Order Optical Nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Second harmonic generation (SHG) and propagation loss have been measured on nano-crystallized optical fibers from a tellurite based glass. Angular dependence of SHG intensity and low propagation loss (0.15 dB/cm) at 1.55 micrometer are reported.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 10 Gb/s C+L band InP-based Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a 10 Gb/s InP-based Mach-Zehnder Modulator with Ru-doped buried hetero-structure waveguides. C and L band operation is demonstrated, including transmission over 103 km of SMF for 1528-1600 nm.

articleTitle: Archimedean-like lattice microstructured optical fibers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a novel microstructured optical fiber design consisting of an Archimedean-like lattice of air holes surrounding a solid central core. We show that this cladding structure substantially improves the circularity of the fundamental mode.

articleTitle: Reduction of Signal-Induced Rayleigh Noise in a 10Gb/s WDM-PON using a Gain-Saturated SOA
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate mitigation of signal-induced Rayleigh-beat-noise in a carrier-distributed WDM-PON using a gain-saturated SOA. The required signal-to-Rayleigh power was reduced by 11dB thereby enabling 10Gb/s error-free transmission in a 64 way-split, 20km reach PON.

articleTitle: Polarization Independent All-Optical Clock Recovery from Highly Distorted Data Signals
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A polarization independent multiwavelength all-optical clock recovery scheme based on a birefringent resonator is introduced. We verify proper operation of the method with data signals highly distorted by dispersion and fiber nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Polarization-Insensitive GaInNAs / GaInAs MQW-SOA with Low Noise Figure and Small Gain Tilt over 90-nm Bandwidth (1510 1600 nm)
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed a polarization-insensitive GaInNAs/GaInAs MQW-SOA with a small gain tilt of < 1.2 dB in C-band. The reduced NF increased the effective gain bandwidth by 50 nm as compared with a GaInNAs strained-bulk SOA.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Optical Grid Scheduling through Dimensioning
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Optical Grids promise cost and resource efficient delivery of (distributed) services. We propose an optical Grid dimensioning methodology, and use it to evaluate the effect of Grid scheduling algorithms on the dimensions of such Grids.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Reduced Complexity 43-Gb/s RZDQPSK Rate-Tunable Receiver
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate an alternative DQPSK receiver offering reduced complexity through sharing of hardware in the I/Q demodulation paths. Demodulation of 43-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK is demonstrated without penalty relative to a traditional DQPSK receiver. Rate tuning is demonstrated through demodulation of a 21.5 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signal with the same receiver structure.

articleTitle: Nanoparticle-Doped Microstructured Polymer Optical Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A generic method has been developed which utilises functional nanoparticles as a universal dopant delivery system for embedding material into microstructured polymer optical fibres (mPOF). Doping experience with silica nanoparticles and quantum dots is presented.

articleTitle: Theoretical Analysis and Primary Experimental Verification of Reflectometric Measurement of Polarization Mode Dispersion in an Optical Fiber Link
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate theoretically and experimentally that the differential group delay and differential attenuation slope of an optical fiber with polarization-dependent loss can be explicitly obtained by reflectometric measurements in optical frequency and fiber length domains.

articleTitle: Reduction of intra-channel four-wave mixing through pairwise or pulseto- pulse alternate polarization of carrier-suppressed RZ signals
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: It is shown that a combination of pairwise or pulse-to-pulse alternate polarization and 67% duty cycle carrier-suppressed return-to-zero (CSRZ) achieves additional reduction of intra-channel four-wave mixing compared to bit-to-bit alternate polarization in 40 Gbit/s systems.

articleTitle: Widely tunable Wavelength Exchange in Anomalous-dispersion Regime
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate the tunability of wavelength exchange using two pumps in the anomalous-dispersion region. Complete wavelength exchange is achieved with tuning range >15nm. Bit error rate of <10-9 is maintained with power penalties of ~2dB.

articleTitle: Dos and Donts for the Emulation of Four-Wave Mixing in 10Gb/s WDM Systems Based on Low-Dispersion Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We numerically investigate simulation conditions to accurately emulate the impact of four-wave mixing in 10Gbit/s systems based on low-dispersion fibre, such as the statistical impact of phase/time shifts between channel or combs of channels.

articleTitle: Chromatic dispersion and OSNR monitoring in a WDM 40Gbit/s system
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A technique based on spectral analysis after frequency down-conversion for multi-impairment monitoring in 40Gbit/s multi-channel systems is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The use of electrooptic down-conversion makes it cost effective for multi-channel operation.

articleTitle: Cost and Performance Comparison in Data Vortex networks with and without shared traffic control
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Data Vortex networks that operate with shared traffic control allow for lower cost and better system performance. The routing efficiency is improved especially under bursty traffic operations.

articleTitle: 1 Gbit/s Full-Duplex Bidirectional Optical Data Transmission over 500 m of 50 micrometer-Core Graded-Index Multimode Fiber with Novel Monolithically
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present bidirectional data transmission experiments in half- and full-duplex mode at 1 Gbit/s data rate over 500 m graded-index multimode fiber with VCSELs and MSM photodiodes as parts of a GaAs-based monolithically integrated transceiver chip.

articleTitle: Remotely Powered Optical Switch for Remote Subscriber Aggregation and OTDR Measurement in PON
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present for the first time remote powering of a 3-D MEMS for optical switching using light over fibre. The low power switch with integrated optical splitters is suitable at non-powered remote PON distribution sites.

articleTitle: Local Area networking in a Multi-functional Repeater-based Optical Access Network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A simpler and bandwidth efficient scheme for providing local area networking amongst the customers in a multi functional repeater-based optical access network is proposed and experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: On-demand uncompressed HDTV Transmission over a GMPLS controlled Service-Aware all-optical network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An intelligent optical network needs to address the heterogeneous requirements that new services like on-demand, uncompressed HDTV transmission impose, jointly considering management, control and transport planes. Such a transmission was assesed over a GMPLS network.

articleTitle: 20GHz Channel Spacing InP-based Arrayed Waveguide Grating
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a 10-channel InP-based Arrayed-Waveguide Grating (dimensions = 5.0x6.0 mm2) with a 20-GHz channel spacing. The excess loss of the AWG is 5.5-6.3 dB, and the crosstalk level is below -15 dB.

articleTitle: Integrated Si3N4/SiO2 Slot-Waveguide Microresonators
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate slot-waveguide microring resonators and Fabry-Perot microcavities on Si3N4/SiO2. Characterization indicates guiding and confinement in the waveguide nanometric-size low-index slot region at Oband (1260-1370nm) wavelengths. We measured propagation losses <20 dB/cm.

articleTitle: Advanced Modulation Formats for Electronic Predistortion of Intrachannel Nonlinearities at 40 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The role of the target modulation format (at the receiver) in electronically predistorted 40 Gbit/s transmission is studied by comparing various on-off-keying formats. Best performance is achieved for CS-RZ as the target format.

articleTitle: Temperature-Insensitive Strain Measurement with PM-PCF based Sagnac Interferometer
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Temperature-insensitive strain measurement is realized by using a polarization-maintaining photonic crystal fibre (PM-PCF) Sagnac interferometer. The achieved sensitivity is 0.23 pm/muepsilon. The measurement range, by stretching the PM-PCF only, is up to 32 mepsilon.

articleTitle: Wavelength Cross-Connect Switching System with Dynamic Capacity Control that uses PLC-based WSS
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a wavelength cross-connect (WXC) Switching System with dynamic capacity control that uses Planar-Lightwave-Circuit (PLC)-based wavelength selective switch (WSS). The switching system can realize fast capacity control with simple end-to-end communication.

articleTitle: Injection Locked DBR Laser Diode module for Access Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A Distributed Bragg Reflector laser diode has been packaged and characterised in an injection locking configuration for access applications. A modulation Bandwidth of 5GHz and a chirp parameter as low as 1.2 have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Progress in 1.55 micrometer vertical cavity (VCSEL) surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on recent progress in long-wavelength VCSEL research. High-speed (10 Gbit/s), high temperature and high power (>1 mW @ 85deg C) operation has been achieved with Buried Tunnel Junction (BTJ) VCSELs at 1.55 micrometer emission wavelength.

articleTitle: A Color-Free WDM-PON Employing Fabry-Prot Laser Diodes Without a Seed Light Injection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a WDM-PON by employing a double-contact Fabry-Prot Laser Diodes without a seed light injection. To avoid the high MPN at low frequency, we use a BPSK as a modulation format at a low RIN window. An error-free transmission is achieved by compensating a lasing envelope shift with the double contact F-P LD.

articleTitle: Un-cooled operation (10 deg C to 85 deg C) of a 10.7-Gbit/s 1.55-micrometer electroabsorption modulator integrated DFB laser for 40-km transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A modulated output-power more than +3.7 dBm, a dynamic extinction-ratio over 9.3 dB, and a powerpenalty below 1.8 dB were achieved for 10.7-Gbit/s, 40-km transmission over a wide temperature range from 10 deg C to 85 deg C.

articleTitle: 12.5Gbps/ch Transmission in Polymer Waveguide with 4-Channel Circular Graded-Index Cores
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Multimode polymer waveguides with 4-channel circular graded-index cores are fabricated. Because of the parabolic index profile, very low-loss (0.029dB/cm) and high-bandwidth (83Gbps m) are achieved, and a transmission of 12.5-Gbps for 3 m is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Compensation of Non-linear Phase-shift in Incoherent Multilevel Receiver with Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A simple cancellation technique of SPM-induced phase shift in amplitude- and phase-modulated signalling is proposed and experimentally demonstrated in 100-km transmissions of 40-Gbit/s 16-level and 50- Gbit/s 32-level signals with >6.8 dB increase of input power.

articleTitle: Fabrication of 300-nm-period nanostructure in a bulk fused silica
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on the first recording of a 300-nm-period structure in a permanently moving sample of a pure fused silica using the tightly-focused, 82 nJ, 267 nm, 300 fs, 1 kHz laser pulses.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on Temperature and Strain Dependence of Brillouin Frequency Shifts in GeO2-Doped Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The strain- or temperature-coefficient of Brillouin frequency shift is shown to be a quadratic function of draw-tension during fiber fabrication. The coefficients decrease by 1.48 % and 1.61 % respectively for a unit mol% increase of GeO2 concentration.

articleTitle: POF Sensors applications in every days life
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In this paper we will show some representative examples that demonstrate the capabilities of sensors based on polymer optical fibres and their real applications. Furthermore we will show, how progress in the sensor area is stimulated by developments in the communication sector.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Signal Distortion in 42.7 Gb/s Duobinary Transmission Using a Single Chip Optical Equalizer
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally investigated the ability of optical equalizers to mitigate signal distortion caused by chromatic dispersion, intrachannel fiber nonlinearities and cascaded filters in 42.7 Gb/s duobinary transmission.

articleTitle: Pluggable inter-plane couplers for multilayer optical interconnections
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present pluggable inter-plane coupling components which can be used to route signals in boardlevel multilayer optical interconnections. The components are prototyped using Deep Proton Writing, but are compatible with low-cost mass fabrication.

articleTitle: 1 x 12 VCSEL Array at 1.55 m for High-Bandwidth at Metro-Range
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: For a monolithically integrated 1x12 VCSEL array a per-channel bandwidth of 10 Gb/s over 20 km of standard single-mode fibre (SSMF) is demonstrated. The emission wavelength is addressable by current-tuning without any bit-error-rate (BER) penalty.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s Error-Free Transmission through a 100-km Fibre Link with Mid-Span All-Optical SOA-Based Wavelength Conversion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: 160 Gb/s error-free transmission with acceptable penalty levels is demonstrated through a 50-km fibre link followed by a high-speed all-optical SOA-based wavelength converter and subsequently followed by another 50-km fibre link.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of PPLN+RSOA-based Tunable All-Optical NRZ-to-RZ Format Conversion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel scheme of all-optical NRZ-to-RZ format conversion at 10 Gb/s and 20 Gb/s using a PPLN and a RSOA. Tunable operation and single-to-dual channel conversion are successfully observed in the experiment.

articleTitle: PMD Tolerance Enhancement by Adaptive Receiver for 43Gb/s DPSK NRZ- and RZ-Modulation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We compared experimentally PMD tolerances of an adaptively equalising 43Gb/s receiver for DPSK NRZ/RZ formats taking into account first and second order PMD. At 10-5 outage an improvement of PMD tolerance by 55% is found.

articleTitle: Experimental studies of bandwidth behaviour in Graded Index Microstructured Polymer Optical Fibres
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper presents theoretical and experimental studies of graded index microstructured polymer optical fibres (GImPOF), characterising the bandwidth, differential mode delay and equilibrium length. The results will be compared to conventional polymer optical fibres.

articleTitle: Analysis of Closed Amplified Cycles in WSS ROADM based Mesh Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report experimental and numerical stability analysis of closed amplified optical cycles formed by mesh network with WSS ROADM.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI) Delay-Line Interferometer with Low Polarization-Dependent Frequency Shift for 40 Gbit/s DPSK Demodulation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A 40 Gbit/s SOI rib-waveguide delay-&-add interferometer is presented. Across the C-band we demonstrate high uniformity, low loss, PDL, and PDFS (< 1 GHz). RZ & NRZ DPSK balanced-detection measurements at 40 Gbit/s are included.

articleTitle: Can SSMF handle ULH 40-Gb/s WDM transmission?
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally compare the performance of the SSMF and UltraWaveTM fibers for ULH 40 Gb/s WDM transmissions, with both the CSRZ-ASK and CSRZ-DPSK modulation formats. We show that ULH transmission distances (>2000 km) can be reached on SSMF by using the CSRZ-DPSK format only, thus proving that SSMF-based infrastructure of incumbent carriers can be used at 40 Gb/s channel rates on ULH distances.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Slow Light on RZ-DQPSK Signals
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate 60-ps symbol-delay with error-free demodulation of both quadratures for 10-Gb/s RZDQPSK via a SBS-based slow-light medium. Simulation results propose the possibility to transmit very-high spectrally-efficient formats through a bandwidth-limited slow-light element.

articleTitle: Generalized MPLS (GMPLS) Recovery Mechanisms at IETF
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A requirement for the development of a unified control plane for both optical/circuit and electronic/packet switching equipment is the support of data plane fault recovery. This paper describes the data path recovery mechanisms, i.e. protection and re-routing, defined as part of the GMPLS protocol suite (as defined by the IETF).

articleTitle: Bismuth-Oxide Highly Nonlinear Fiber Based Dispersion Imbalanced Loop Mirror for RZ Signal Regeneration
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated a compact dispersion imbalanced loop mirror for RZ signal regeneration using a 32- cm bismuth-oxide highly-nonlinear fiber. BER measurement was performed with a 10-Gb/s 2(exp31)-1 PRBS. The receiver sensitivity was improved by 6 dB.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of PMD Compensation by LDPC-Coded Turbo Equalization
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The possibility of PMD compensation by using LDPC-coded turbo equalization is demonstrated experimentally for NRZ systems operating at 10-Gb/s. Significant BER performance improvement over the optimum threshold receiver is obtained.

articleTitle: Dual-mode Time-bin Coding for Quantum Key Distribution Using Dual-drive Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a new method of coding for quantum key distribution using a commercial dual-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator. This method allows the user to switch between two coding modes merely by changing the driving sequence of the modulator. We obtained error rates (0.7%) sufficiently low for practical use.

articleTitle: Maximum-Likelihood Phase Estimation for Coherent Optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a robust and computation-efficient method of maximum-likelihood phase estimation. Both computer simulation and transmission experiment of coherent optical OFDM system show that maximumlikelihood decision- feedback following pilot-assisted phase estimation gives the optimal performance.

articleTitle: 100-Gbps Optical Packets with 8-bit RZ Pulse Patterns Generated by an Optical Pulse Synthesizer
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We successfully generated optical packets by the feedback control of an optical pulse synthesizer. Arbitrary 8-bit RZ pulse packets with a bit rate of 100 Gbps were experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Electronic Dispersion Compensation for 107Gb/s Coherent Detection with Multi-Level Modulation Formats
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate the performance of electronic dispersion compensation for coherent detection with a zero-forcing equalizer approach, using the minimum mean-square error criterion, for RZ-QPSK, RZ-8PSK and Star-RZ-16QAM for the linear and nonlinear channel at 107Gb/s.

articleTitle: Advance Reservation Algorithm for Service Oriented Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Advance Reservation (AR) and Immediate Reservation (IR) service provisioning requires complex algorithmic approaches to guarantee QoS. In this paper we propose and evaluate an algorithm which significantly decreases connection preemption rates of IR requests.

articleTitle: Optical coupling of active components and polymer based optical waveguide boards
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Optical coupling between active components and polymer based optical waveguide boards are addressed. Using a waveguide chip as optical adapter the coupling loss between laser diodes and single-mode fibres can be reduced by some 6dB.

articleTitle: Dynamic Channel Allocation Experiment in DWDM Millimeter-wave Radio-on-Fiber Access Network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time dynamic channel allocation capability of millimetre-wave band optical RoF signals in WDM access network using a supercontinuum multi-wavelength light source, arrayed-waveguide gratings and a reconfigurable optical crossconnect switch.

articleTitle: Cascadability Assessment of an All Optical 3R Regenerator based on Synchronous Modulation in a Saturable Absorber and Optical Clock Recovery
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on the cascadability assessment of 3R regeneration based on optical synchronous modulation using cross saturation absorption in a quantum-well microcavity driven optically by the recovered clock from a self-pulsating laser device.

articleTitle: Monitoring of DPSK/DQPSK Signals using 1-Bit Delayed Self-Homodyne Detection with Optical Phase Diversity
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed a method for analysing DPSK/DQPSK signals using 1-bit delayed self-homodyne detection. A clear difference in the 40-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK signals was observed in the analytical distributions of transitional amplitude and phase variations.

articleTitle: Multimode Fibers Optimized for High Speed, Short Reach Interconnects
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Laser-optimized multimode fibers with parallel and CWDM optics offer a path for extending the costeffectiveness of 10Gbps links based on 850nm VCSELs to the 100Gb Ethernet space. Both fiber and system developments will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Engineering Spectral Hole Burning and Carrier Exhaustion Mechanisms on the Gain Saturation Behavior of Quantum-Dot Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We theoretically investigate how spectral hole burning and carrier-exhaustion affect the gain saturation spectra of a quantum-dot optical amplifier at various operation conditions and how they can be tuned to change the functionality.

articleTitle: A Scalable All-optical VPN in Multiple PONs with a Two-stage TDM-WDM Architecture
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate optical VPN among different PONs using ASK/FSK format. The scalability is enhanced by using a bidirectional amplifier at the OLT and the FSK format combined with low-loss FBG reflectors for VPN traffic.

articleTitle: Discrete Multi-Tone Modulation for Low-Cost and Robust 10-Gb/s Transmission over Polymer Optical Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: Utilizing a transmission bandwidth of 2 GHz, we demonstrate 10.6-Gb/s transmission (11.9-Gb/s including overhead) over 100 m of 120-micrometer core-diameter graded-index polymer optical fibre with discrete multi-tone modulation, achieving a spectral efficiency of 5.3 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: 1-bit/s/Hz Spectral Efficiency OCDM Technique Based on Multi-frequency Homodyne Detection and Optical OFDM
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel OCDM technique that combines multi-frequency homodyne detection and optical OFDM to achieve 1-bit/s/Hz spectral efficiency without polarization multiplexing. Numerical simulation results show the validity and performance of this technique.

articleTitle: Polarization-Diversity Turbo-Equalization of Polarization Mode Dispersion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel method based on polarization-diversity and iterative-equalization is proposed to combat polarization mode dispersion (PMD). Simulation results are presented that show considerable gain over MLSE-receivers without polarization-diversity.

articleTitle: In-service Line Monitoring System using 1650 nm Brillouin OTDR for 8-branched PON Fibres with Individually Assigned BFSs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We design an in-service line monitoring system using 1650 nm B-OTDR for measuring 8-branched PON fibres with individually assigned Brillouin frequency shifts, and obtain individual B-OTDR traces of 8-branched PON fibres.

articleTitle: Design and performance of low-cost WDM-PON access networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Design and performance of low-cost wavelength division multiplexed-passive optical network (WDMPON) candidates are presented. The relative system costs of the candidates are also estimated.

articleTitle: New Easily Assembled Mechanical Splicer for Direct Coated Optical Fibre Connection without Stripping and Cleaning
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a new type of mechanical splicer that provides easy assembly. It has good performance with a low average insertion loss of 0.2 dB and a high return loss of over 46 dB.

articleTitle: Impact of router bypass using optical transport on control load during failure recovery
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
