abstract: In IP backbone networks, router bypass using optical transport technology reduces network cost while increasing meshing of routers. This paper provides new results on the impact on the control load for a realistic network scenario.

articleTitle: The effect of polarization mode dispersion on gain and delay spectra of Raman assisted narrow band fiber parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We describe the influence of birefringence on the spectral shapes of both gain and delay in a narrow band optical parametric amplifier, based on a novel vector model which accounts for most nonlinear interaction mechanisms.

articleTitle: Hybrid WDM/TDM-PON Using Remotely Pumped Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: It was shown that the remote pumping scheme increases the optical loss budget up-to 24dB for the hybrid WDM/TDM-PON, where the coherent seed light injected R-SOA is used as the colourless transmitter.

articleTitle: Reducing the Back Reflection-Induced Penalty by Using a Receiver with an Optimized Decision Level in a lambda-Reuse Single Fiber Bidirectional WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present the use of an optical receiver with an optimized decision-level for reducing the back reflection-induced degradation of an upstream transmission in a lambda-reuse single fiber bidirectional RSOA-based WDM PON.

articleTitle: Outage and Capacity Based Path Selection in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a new method to determine the overall probability of successful path selection in alloptical networks, considering both blocking probability from traffic and wavelength utilisation and outage probability from multiple physical layer impairments.

articleTitle: Potential of hole-assisted fibres in optical access and in-house networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Hole-assisted fibre (HAF) has an extremely low bending loss characteristic compared with conventional fibre. We describe recent progress on optical wiring technologies based on HAF, which enables us to offer simple and economical FTTH installation.

articleTitle: Enhanced Kerr Non-linearity in Sub-wavelength Diameter As2Se3 Chalcogenide Fibre Tapers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate enhanced Kerr non-linear effects in tapered highly non-linear As2Se3 chalcogenide fibre with 1.2 micrometer waist diameter. We observe enhanced non-linearity of 68.4 W-1m-1, which is 45,000 times larger than standard silica single-mode fibre.

articleTitle: Impact of strong optical filtering on DQPSK modulation formats
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We study the influence of strong optical filtering on DQPSK modulation formats and show that the performance can be significantly improved by using a delay- interferometer with larger free spectral range.

articleTitle: DEEP-FIBER BROADBAND ACCESS NETWORKS
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper looks into two recent standards, GPON and VDSL2 as means of deploying large scale FTTx networks. Respective technologies and topologies are described together with lessons learned during several years of practical FTTx deployment.

articleTitle: Using Sub-sampled Fiber Bragg Gratings to Achieve Laser Sources Compatible OCDMA En/decoders
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel sub-sampling technology is given, which can be used to manufacture multiple en/decoders for different wavelengths with one phase mask. The proposed method is experimentally proven to fit for WDM compatible OCDMA system.

articleTitle: Highly efficient generation of cascaded Four-Wave Mixing products in a Hybrid Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on highly efficient generation of cascaded four-wave products over 110nm, covering C and L bands. It has been gotten by launching two lasers near one zero-dispersion wavelength of a Hybrid Photonic Crystal Fiber.

articleTitle: Performance of 2.5 Gb/s and 10 Gb/s transient and adiabatic chirped directly modulated lasers using electronic dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: For the first time to our knowledge we study the efficiency of electronic dispersion compensation when transient and adiabatic chirped directly modulated lasers operating at 2.5 Gbps and 10 Gbps are used.

articleTitle: 5.7dB SBS suppression with a HNLF (module) Comprised of 3 HNLFs having Different GeO2 Concentration
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated 5.7dB SBS suppression of a HNLF by controlling Brillouin gain spectrum with three HNLFs which have different GeO2 concentration. FWM wavelength conversion efficiency is improved by 5.7dB comparing to conventional HNLFs.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s optical time-division demultiplexing by four-wave mixing in a 5 cm length ultra-high nonlinear As2S3 waveguide
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An As2S3 waveguide with ultra-high optical Kerr nonlinearity ~ 2000 W-1km-1 demonstrates highperformance time-division demultiplexing of a 160 Gb/s signal into its tributary 10 Gb/s channels via four-wave mixing in just a 50 mm length device.

articleTitle: Link Management Protocol extensions for OMS protection in GMPLS-based optical ring networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In this paper we propose a mechanism to provide dedicated section protection in ring-based optical networks. It is based on extensions to GMPLS Link Management Protocol (LMP) and its performance is experimentally evaluated.

articleTitle: ASON survivability testbed supporting p-cycles protection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A distributed testbed SURBED (Survivability Testbed for Automatically Switched Optical Networks) supporting p-cycles protection is proposed and demonstrated. Based on SURBED the performances of several traditional survival mechanisms and a p-cycles protection algorithm are evaluated.

articleTitle: Strategies for the Migration from Opaque to Hybrid Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Cost analyses usually compare fully opaque to fully hybrid networks. However no operator can afford migrating in one step its entire network. We address different migration strategies and identify the optimal levels of network transparency.

articleTitle: Optimization of an optical OFDM system by peak to average signal ratio reduction
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The optimization of an O-OFDM system is studied by reduction of peak to average signal ratio using clipping and an increase of average modulation. An improvement of 9 dB for 2(exp7)-1 and 14 dB for 2(exp15)-1 pattern is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Mitigation of XGM and Add/Drop Induced Penalties in SOA-based Metro WDM Ring Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Performance of link control techniques in SOA-based metro WDM-ring networks has been characterized in steady-state and dynamic conditions; such techniques in short-span ring networks provide XGM reduction, effective OSNR improvement and significant BER transient reduction during add/drop operation.

articleTitle: Novel Architectures of Asynchronous Optical Packet Switch
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose two asynchronous optical packet switch architectures, with efficient contention resolution based on controllable optical buffers and tunable wavelength converters TWCs. Providing a few shared optical buffers significantly boosts the performance obtained by TWCs.

articleTitle: Tunable Pulse Delay Using Spectral Filtering from a Nonlinearly Broadened Optical Spectrum and Group Velocity Dispersion in a Chirped Fiber Bragg
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Optically-controlled variable delay up to 415 ps is demonstrated for 10-GHz pulses using self-phase and cross-phase modulations in a 32-cm bismuth-oxide highly nonlinear fiber followed by group velocity dispersion in a chirped fiber Bragg grating.

articleTitle: Performance of Electronic Pre-Distortion in 40-Gb/s Systems with Optical Dispersion Compensation for Different Modulation Formats and Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show that the performance improvement obtained by electronic pre-distortion in 40-Gb/s transmission systems with different fibres using in-line optical dispersion compensators is limited to about 3 dB by inter-channel cross-phase-modulation for both on-off-keying and differential-phase-shift-keying.

articleTitle: Architecture and Performance of a Bidirectional OXC Based on Reversible Optical Switches with Reduced Complexity
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: By exploiting the symmetry of bidirectional wavelength-connections in WDM networks, we propose an NN bidirectional OXC using one N/2N/2 reversible optical switch to reduce the complexity of the OXCs. The feasibility is demonstrated at 10 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Analysis of backscattered optical signals in narrow spectrum remote feeding single-fibre links employing RSOAs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We assess the bounds that Brillouin and Rayleigh backscattering impose to single fibre optical links that use narrow spectrum optical sources acting as feeders of RSOAs for upstream transmission.

articleTitle: Cascaded Long Period Fibre Grating-Based DPSK Demodulator with Optically Tunable Phase Shifter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A DPSK demodulator based on cascaded long period fibre grating is proposed. The performance of the demodulator is demonstrated for a 10-Gb/s DPSK system, showing clear eye diagram as well as bit error free performance.

articleTitle: High control in high power fiber lasers and amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We discuss fundamental aspects and future prospects of high power fiber lasers and amplifiers with particular attention to high control of cladding-pumped, rare-earth-doped fiber sources in a multitude of regimes.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of OBS and OCS for VoD Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We study the performance of video-on-demand (VoD) applications under various network and traffic parameters in optical networks. The results show that optical burst switching (OBS) is more suitable for supporting VoD applications than optical circuit-switching (OCS).

articleTitle: Generation of new Frequencies by Pulse Splitting
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a pulse splitting mechanism by third-order dispersion in the normal dispersion regime, which leads to the excitation of new frequency components on the red side of the pulse spectrum.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Contention Resolution and 100 km Transmission for IP/10GbE over 80 Gbit/s (8lambda x 10 Gbit/s) Colored Optical Packet Switching
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Contention resolution and 100 km transmission of 80 (8lambda x 10) Gbit/s colored-optical-packets encapsulating IP packets with packet-loss-rate of less than 10-6 have been demonstrated by IP/optical-packet converters, optical fiber-delay-line buffers, and transient-response-suppressed EDFAs.

articleTitle: Integrated Mux/Demux with 25/50GHz interleavers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Pair of 50/25 GHz interleavers was integrated on a single chip using high index contrast planar waveguide technology. The cascaded MZ-based interleaver uses a polarization diversified scheme and achieved 25dB crosstalk and 18GHz 0.5dB bandwidth across the C-band.

articleTitle: Low Timing Jitter Phase-Locked Loop for Versatile and Adaptive Synchronization in High Bit Rate Optical Sampling Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel scheme for synchronization of sampling pulse trains to optical data streams is presented. Besides generation of ordinary eye diagrams it facilitates waveform visualization of repetitive (including PRBS) data words using word-synchronous sampling.

articleTitle: 1,000-km Polarization-Interleaved WDM Transmission of 20-Gbit/s QPSK Signals on the Frequency Grid with 12.5-GHz Channel Spacing using Digital
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Polarization-interleaved 20-Gbit/s QPSK signals on the 12.5-GHz-spaced grid are transmitted over 1,074 km. Using a digital coherent receiver to demultiplex such ultra-dense WDM QPSK signals, we achieve spectral efficiency as high as 1.6 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Spatial and Spectral Transparency Using Ultra-long Fibre Laser Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and experimentally implement ultra-long laser links providing cross-domain transparency over space and frequency, applicable to communications and signal processing. Full transparency over a 20 nm window is demonstrated for a 20 km span

articleTitle: A Fault-Tolerant OBS Node Architecture with Resilient Buffers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate a novel fault-tolerant node architecture using a resilient buffer (R-buffer) in optical burst switching (OBS) networks. Our study shows that most of the lost bursts can be restored quickly using the architecture.

articleTitle: OTN-overhead based Optical-Path Performance Management in the NMS of GMPLS-Controlled All-Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: OTN-overhead based optical-path performance management was succesfully demonstrated in the network management system of GMPLS-controlled all-optical networks. Intensional bit error ratio (BER) degradation was appropriately detected and isolated by tracing the BER along the optical-path.

articleTitle: All Optical Recognition of 36 SAC-Labels with 12.5 GHz minimum Bin Separation using a Single Correlator for Optical Label Switching
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a 36-code spectral-amplitude-code family for optical-label recognition. A nonlinear device followed by a 12.5 GHz channel AWG generates a control signal for all-optical switching of a 40Gbps payload among up to 36 ports.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Modified Hadamard Codes for OCDM-based Confidentiality
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We implement novel orthogonal codes using a complex monomial matrix transformation on the conventional Hadamard codes for a spectral phase-encoded OCDM system. The resulting exponentially larger code space is invaluable for potentially enhancing data confidentiality.

articleTitle: Data Rate and Distance Scaling of CO-OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Simulations show the BER performance of a coherent optical OFDM system with different cyclic prefix lengths. We derive a design rule, which allows data rate and distance scaling while maintaining tolerance to chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Dynamic Switching of High Powered Picosecond Pulses from a Quantum Dot Mode-locked Laser Diode using an Integrated Quantum Dot Switch
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An integrated quantum-dot switch is presented exhibiting on-chip gain of 19dB and saturation powers in excess of 13dB. Dynamic switching of 10ps, 5ps and 1ps pulses is presented with peak powers in excess of 170mW.

articleTitle: Coherent RZ-8PSK Transmission at 30Gbit/s over 1200km Employing Homodyne Detection with Digital Carrier Phase Estimation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Coherent optical RZ-8PSK transmission over 1200km is experimentally demonstrated for the first time employing homodyne detection with 8-th power digital phase estimation. Accompanying simulations detail the theoretical system performance and potential of coherent 8PSK.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 3-lambda810 Gbps WDM/DPSK-OCDMA using 31-chip, 640 Gchip/s SSFBG En/decoder for 10 G Flexible Access Network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a high data-rate SSFBG-based WDM/OCDMA experiment (3 wavelengths with 100 GHz spacing, 8 OCDMA, 10 Gbps/user) using 31-chip, 640 Gchip/s en/decoders, DPSK modulation, time gating and FEC.

articleTitle: A Wideband Low-distorted ROSA for Video Distribution Service based on FM Conversion Scheme
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A receiver optical sub-assembly (ROSA) has been developed for video distribution service based on FM conversion scheme. The ROSA features a wide bandwidth of 0.05-10.5 GHz and a low duty-cycle-distortion of <1- % even for large power input of +1 dBm.

articleTitle: 100Mb/s Transmissions over Short Reach SI-POF Links: Experimental Demonstration of Extended Reach Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present record results for extended reach 1-mm SI-POF systems, using equalization and 8-PAM to overcome POF bandwidth limitations. We experimentally demonstrate error-free transmission at 100-Mbit/s over a 200m link and reliable transmission after FEC over a 275m link.

articleTitle: All-optical Broadband Tunable Wavelength Multicasting using a Pump- Modulated Wide-Band Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifier with High and Flat Gain
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical broadband wavelength multicasting scheme using a pump-modulated optical parametric amplifier. =11-dB ER and =8-dB eye-opening Q are obtained through a 64-nm bandwidth with high (=28 dB) and flat (~3-dB variation) gain.

articleTitle: Small volume (0.6 cc) surface mount 10-Gbit/s Mini Flat Mach-Zehnder modulator module
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed a small size InP Mach-Zehnder (MZ) modulator module for use in a small form transponder, which is only 13.8x8.9x4.9 mm3 in size (0.6 cc). We confirmed a 100 km transmission through SMF with a 10-Gbit/s NRZ signal and a 220 km transmission with a 10-Gbit/s optical duobinary signal.

articleTitle: High Brightness Tapered Lasers based on Quantum Dots at 920 nm with Enhanced Temperature Stability of the Emission Wavelength for Uncooled Pump
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Low-aperture index-guided tapered lasers based on InGaAs-quantum dots are demonstrated with low temperature induced wavelength shift of 0.14 nm/K (P=900 mW) suitable for integration in laser bars. Gain-guided lasers exhibit output powers of 3 W.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Spectral Efficiency of Filter-Assisted Wavelength Conversion for Polarity-Preserving Operation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigated by means of numerical simulations the influence of the data duty-cycle on the efficiency of filter-assisted wavelength conversion. The data polarity is kept without the need of an additional notch filter.

articleTitle: Quantum Dot Semiconductor Optical Amplifier at 1.3micrometer for Ultra-Fast Cross-Gain Modulation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Measured gain and phase dynamics of InAs/GaAs quantum dot amplifiers reveal small alpha-factors. This enables ultra-fast cross-gain modulation which speeds up with increasing injection current and depends only weakly on the optical peak power.

articleTitle: Numerical and Experimental Investigation of the Effect of Dispersion on Nonlinear Phase Noise in RZ-DPSK Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Using a novel Karhunen-Love expansion method, we verify numerically and experimentally that the effect of dispersion can improve the performance of RZ-DPSK systems when nonlinear phase noise is the dominant impairment.

articleTitle: Experimental Synchronization/Multiplexing of Optical Data Packets using a Reconfigurable and Continuously-Tunable Optical Delay Based on Wavelength
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: 10Gb/s Optical data packets are synchronized and multiplexed by using continuously-tunable all-optical delay line with 26.4ns tuning range. Delay reconfigurability is measured to be 276ps.

articleTitle: Comparison of All-Optical XOR Gates at 42.6Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report for the first time the 42.6Gbit/s bit-error rate performance of two types of all-optical XOR gates based on semiconductor optical amplifiers. We compare a hybrid integrated Mach-Zehnder interferometer with a dual UNI arrangement.v

articleTitle: Flexible and Scalable High-Density Quad-play Packet-Switched Access Infrastructure based on WDM Routing and Dynamic TDM Access
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We describe a 2.5 Gbps WDM/TDM PON architecture featuring quad-play connectivity to 8,192 users. 256-times laser-sharing with dynamic bandwidth allocation can offer 60% throughput increase and 50% latency reduction compared to a conventional static network.

articleTitle: 5 Channel (20Gbit/s per Channel) Transmitter Photonic Integrated Circuit for 100GbE Application
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have developed a 100Gbit/s (5channels x 20Gbit/s) transmitter Photonic Integrated Circuit for 100GbE applications, and demonstrated 10km transmission in SMF-28 fiber for short reach applications.

articleTitle: Optically Powered Video Camera Link
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We implemented an optically powered video camera connected to a base station at 200 m distance. Power and 100-Mbps data-channel are multiplexed at 810 nm and 1310 nm into a standard 62.5 micrometer multimode fiber.

articleTitle: 10-Gb/s Slow-light Performance Based on SBS Effect in Optical Fiber using NRZ and PSBT Modulation Formats
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: For the first time, we have demonstrated error-free operation of slow-light via SBS in optical fiber for 10-Gb/s NRZ and PSBT formats. The PSBT signal sensivity is 5.2dB better than the NRZ case for a 35-ps delay.

articleTitle: Extremely miniaturized bi-directional module with a single conventional f5.6mm TO-package and a single ball-lens
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An extremely miniaturized bi-directional module with very low cost has been successfully developed by using a single conventional phi 5.6mm TO-package and a single ball-lens. It exhibited excellent performance by minimizing optical and electrical cross-talk.

articleTitle: High-frequency Radio over fibre QPSK transmission through a 5 Km Multimode Fibre link
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report the experimental demonstration of Subcarrier multiplexed signals from 3 to 18 GHz through a 5 Km graded-index multimode fibre link. These are the highest values ever reported in terms of frequency and distance.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Different Data Rate Adaptation Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Different data rate adaptation mechanism and their influence on network and traffic characteristics are visualized in radar plots in order to provide a fast and fair comparison of multiple parameters at the same time.

articleTitle: All-optical latching circuit controlled by a 2-bit all-optical correlator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The routing functionality by all-optically interconnecting semiconductor-based optical logic gates and flipflops is demonstrated in the frame of an all-optical label swapping network. High extinction ratios are obtained at the output of the flip-flop.

articleTitle: Development of GE-PON ONU PX-20 optical transceiver with wide temperature range from -20 to +85 degree C for outdoor operation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have developed PX-20 optical transceiver for GE-PON ONUs with wide temperature range covering -20 to +85 degrees, which is suitable for outdoor equipment. The transceiver successfully supports power budget of 29dB and 20km transmission.

articleTitle: Direct observation of the coherent spectral hole in the noise spectrum of a saturated InAs/InP quantum dash amplifier operating near 1550 nm
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a direct observation of the coherent noise spectral hole in a saturated quantum dash amplifier. Its width 500-600 GHz is determined by the response time and is responsible for high speed regeneration properties.

articleTitle: Penalty Saturation of MLSE-Based Electronic Equalisation in Presence of DGD and Chromatic Dispersion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The MLSE equaliser performance is investigated for large DGD and CD by theoretical bounds and 42.7Gb/s simulations. Due to penalty saturation the required OSNR at DGDs closely above bit duration is dominant.

articleTitle: Adapting the Slow Light spectrum in optical fibers for delay enhancement
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A simple method for the adaptation of the slow light bandwidth of optical fibers is shown. With this method it is possible to change the bandwidth, gain and slope of Brillouin scattering in optical fibers.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of high-reflectance FBG from noisy data
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The inverse scattering problem is studied for high-reflectance grating with noisy reflection data. An adaptive regularization procedure is proposed allowing to reconstruct FBG under relatively strong noise.

articleTitle: Novel Demultiplexing and Error-Free Transmission of 12-Channel Millimeter-Wave-Band Signals in 25-GHz Optical-Frequency-Interleaved DWDM
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a novel demultiplexing and error-free transmission of twelve-channel 60-GHz-band signals over 25-km plus 2-km standard single-mode fibers in optical-frequency-interleaved dense wavelength division multiplexed radio-over-fiber system with 25-GHz channel spacing.

articleTitle: Multiple-Tap Complex-coefficient Incoherent Microwave Photonics Filters using Phase-shifted Fiber Bragg Gratings
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel scheme to implement multi-tap complex coefficient filters based on optical single-sideband modulation and narrow-band optical filtering. A four-tap filter is experimentally demonstrated to highligth the enhanced tuning performance provided by complex coefficients.

articleTitle: Serial and Hybrid Multicast Modes Based on an Active Vertical Coupler Optical Crosspoint Switch
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Serial and hybrid multicast modes using active vertical coupler optical crosspoint switch have been implemented. SNR deterioration of 0.225 dB per increase scale and good eye-diagrams opening are found for serial and hybrid multast, respectively.

articleTitle: Limitations of MLSE-Viterbi receivers due to clocking errors
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Imperfections of clock recovery from highly distorted signals limit the utilization of electronic dispersion mitigation. We investigate the impact of clocking errors on the performance of MLSE-Viterbi equalization using static and adaptive channel estimation.

articleTitle: Photonic Vector Modulation of 3.6 Gb/s 16QAM at 39 GHz for Radio-on- Fibre Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The experimental generation of a 3.6Gb/s-16QAM 39GHz carrier employing Photonic Vector Modulation is reported for the first time. The quadrature condition is introduced using an optical delay line. EVM is estimated from measured eye-diagrams.

articleTitle: Gain analysis for Tb3+-doped fluoride fiber in the 0.54 μm band
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have investigated the amplification performance of Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fluoride fiber in the 0.54μm band based on the numerical analysis, and it has been demonstrated to have the highest gain of 8.3dB, for the first time.

articleTitle: IP over DWDM in core networks: near term and long term goals
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We explain the lP over DWDM architecture, the applications driving it and its advantages and disadvantages. The talk with cover both near term values unique to this approach and its long term vision and goals..

articleTitle: A low-threshold all-Fiber 1000nm-band supercontinuum source
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a low-threshold all-fiber compact supercontinuum source with a nearly flat band from 1.1 micrometer to 2.1micrometer based on a Q-switched fiber laser and a nonlinear dispersion-shifted fiber.

articleTitle: A Radio over Fiber System for Simultaneous Generation and Transmission of Multiband Signals
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and experimentaly demonstrate a novel RoF system for simultaneous generation and transmission of baseband, micro-wave and millimeter-wave signals with a single wavelength using a dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator and a single-drive Mach-Zehnder modulator.

articleTitle: Novel Wavelength Initialization of the Bragg-grating based tunable External Cavity Laser for WDM-PON
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel, but simple wavelength initialization method, without using lookup table, for the Bragg-grating based tunable ECL. The proposed method provides the accuracy such that the wavelengths are initialized within 0.5 nm from the designated ones, which is enough to be used in the WDM-PON with 200GHz wavelength spacing.

articleTitle: 10Gbps x 4ch Arrayed Optical Modules for Petascale Computing Systems using a Novel Assembly Technique
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel assembly technique for compact and cost-effective arrayed optical modules. Using this technique, a 10Gbps x 4ch receiver module of compact size and high sensitivity has been successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: VMAPS: a Versatile Medium Access Control and Processing System for an Optical WDM Metro Ring Network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present the design/experimentation of a versatile medium-access control and processing system (VMAPS) for optical packet-switched WDM networks. VMAPS achieves exceptional MAC performance and enables optical parallel headers to be modified via wavelength-to-time conversion.

articleTitle: Traffic Driven Path Capacity Adjustment Utilizing Adaptive Digital Filter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper proposes a novel method for traffic driven path capacity adjustment. Simulations on the method are performed using an example of real traffic data in an Internet exchange, and its feasibility is experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: Large Effective Area Optical Fibres for Lasers and Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Built-in mode filtering in a leakage channel fibre enables robust fundamental mode operation with effective mode area much larger than that is possible with conventional approaches. Recently effective area exceeding ~3000micrometer2 and PM fibre have been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Tunable Distributed Amplification (TDA-) DFB Laser Array Using Asymmetric Periodic Structure
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We applied two sections with different unit lengths to a TDA-DFB laser array to expand the tuning range. We achieved a tuning range of 6.7 nm for a single laser and 36-channel operation with a 100-GHz grid for a 6-LD array.

articleTitle: Efficient Management of a Telecom Networks Excess Capacity: A Traffic-Engineering Approach
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We utilize a telecom networks Excess Capacity to improve its Quality-of-Service. Our Excess Capacity Management Scheme (ECMS) significantly improves connection availabilities and utilization of network capacity when applied to an optical backbone mesh network.

articleTitle: Analysis of Birefringence Effect in Long Period Gratings through Measurements of Chromatic and Polarization Mode Dispersions
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We model the relationship that exists between the chromatic dispersion and differential group delay in LPG. Our theory, confirmed by experimental results, gives a deeper knowledge of birefringent LPG properties which are complex to model.

articleTitle: Transmission of WDM Multilevel 830 Gbit/s Single Polarization RZ-D8PSK with a Total Capacity of 240 Gbit/s
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: By combining differential 8-ary phase shift keying with wavelength division multiplexing, we present transmission of 8 channel multilevel modulation with 3 bits per symbol. We observed no error-floor down to BER = 10(exp-10).

articleTitle: Guidance and polarization properties of an anisotropic microstructured fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present the fabrication of different microstructured fibres, in which anisotropy is created in the lattice of air-holes by enlarging four air-holes next to the silica core. Guiding properties of the polarization modes are reported.

articleTitle: A Simple Configuration for WDM Full-Duplex Radio-Over-Fiber Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A compact and functionality-centralized configuration is proposed for full-duplex millimeter-wave (mmwave) radio-over-fiber (ROF) systems incorporating wavelength-division multiplexing (WDM).

articleTitle: Future-Proof WDM-PONs with Bandwidth/Wavelength Upgradeable VCSEL arrays
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The continual escalation of bandwidth demand in WDM-PONs is supported with VCSEL arrays that facilitate the migration of CWDM to DWDM operation from 2.5 Gb/s to 80 Gb/s without further investment into transmitter infrastructure.

articleTitle: Simple Approach to Enhance Bidirectional Transmission Performance of WDM-PONs with RSOAs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Inserting a FP etalon in the ONU of WDM-PON systems can provide performance improvement on 10G/1.25-Gbps downstream/upstream transmission by reshaping the low-ER downstream signals that reduce the intensity fluctuation of RSOA-remodulated upstream signals.

articleTitle: Pump-to-Stokes relative intensity noise transfer in Brillouin amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper proposes for the first time an analytical expression of the relative intensity noise (RIN) transfer in Brillouin amplifiers. Theoretical modelling and experimental measurements have been performed in the case of narrow linewidth pump.

articleTitle: More than 40nm tuning DBR-MMI-SOA with only one Bragg current control, compatible with fast switching
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Our new 3DBR-MMI-SOA covers 41nm tuning with only one simultaneous Bragg current, and is compatible with fast switching. Its short cavity and simple tuning mechanism provide large technological tolerances, simple control, and high industrial yield.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of phase matching between two different photonic bandgaps in Hybrid Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated, for the first time, phase matching between 02 different photonic bandgaps of an optical fiber. It was got by launching femtosecond pulses near a zero-dispersion wavelength of Hybrid Photonic Crystal Fibers.

articleTitle: Multiwavelength Erbium-Doped Fiber Laser Based on a Nonlinear Hi-Bi Fiber Loop Mirror
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel multiwavelength erbium-doped fiber laser (EDFL) based on a nonlinear high-birefringence fiber loop mirror (HiBi-FLM) is proposed and demonstrated. Up to 50-wavelength lasing operation with wavelength spacing of 0.8 nm has been achieved.

articleTitle: All-optical switching in liquid-crystal filled lead silicate photonic crystal fiber using transverse coupling geometry
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Up to 25 dB extinction ratio is demonstrated in an all-optical switch based on liquid-crystal filled lead silicate photonic crystal fiber using transverse coupling geometry. An operating range of 600-1700 nm is achieved.

articleTitle: Performance of a 43Gb/s NRZ-DPSK Signal Over a 1440km Commercial 10Gb/s DWDM System, Under Varying DPSK Decoder FSR Values
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate the performance of a 43Gb/s NRZ-DPSK signal over a 1440km commercial 10Gb/s DWDM Network. Utilizing DPSK decoder FSR values of 50GHz and 65GHz, we demonstrate the robustness of the signal to optical filtering.

articleTitle: Infrastructure and Challenges for Convergence of Radio, Fibre and DSL Technologies
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper describes broadband fixed access networks including home networking and services as well as an optical infrastructure for mobile phone networks. Technical challenges for fixed mobile and broadcasting convergence are also discussed.

articleTitle: Fundamental and higher-order mode confinement loss spectrum in realistic air-silica hollow-core Bragg fibers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Silica bridges in realistic air-silica hollow-core Bragg fibers are responsible of the surface mode presence, which interrupt the transmission window of the fundamental and the higher-order modes, narrowing the width useful for light guiding.

articleTitle: Telecom Components for Terahertz Applications: LT InGaAs Photoconductors for Coherent Detection Close the Gap
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A THz system based on fibre connected compact InP-modules is proposed. The hereby missing key device, the photoconductor for coherent THz detection is developed. The functionality is demonstrated in a first THz experiment.

articleTitle: Combined effect of Kerr and Raman nonlinearities on single-pump optical parametric amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate both theoretically and experimentally the influence of the Raman susceptibility on single-pump parametric amplifiers. We discuss the implications of this result for the design of broadband optical parmetric amplfiers.

articleTitle: Large Scale Video Delivery Using Hybrid Packet/Circuit Multicasting: Experiences from Chinese Broadband Network Testbed (3TNet)
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: To support large scale video delivery, we carried out a hybrid packet/circuit multicasting field trial with 26000 users. Each end user has 40 Mb/s guaranteed bandwidth. The results of 1040 concurrent users testing ware reported.

articleTitle: External cavity diffraction-coupled tapered laser diodes
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate the first operation of a corrected tapered laser diode array in an external Talbot cavity. The in-phase supermode is selected with a divergence of the central peak of 0.18deg FWHM.

articleTitle: Joint Resource Allocation in Optical Grids: Algorithms and Performance Study
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper reports the first numerical study of the problem of jointly optimizing job assignment and lightpath establishment (JALE). Several approaches are proposed to efficiently support distributed computing applications in wavelength-routed networks.

articleTitle: Extending the Use of Polymers through Hollow-Core Polymer Fibres
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate kagome lattice hollow-core polymer fibres. The very low overlap between the core mode and the polymer is crucial to the guidance mechanism and allows polymer fibres to be used in the infrared.

articleTitle: Highly efficient, low-pedestal Gaussian pulse compression using dispersion-managed comb-like profiled fiber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We attain highly efficient, low-pedestal Gaussian pulse compression using comb-like profiled fiber (CPF) characterized by normal-dispersion-HNLF. In experiment, input pulse having 2.6ps-FWHM is successfully compressed to 0.39ps-FWHM Gaussian pulse with peak-to-pedestal-ratio of 19.3dB by 3-step-CPF.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wideband Photonic Millimeter-Wave Synthesizers with Coaxial (DC-110GHz) and Rectangular Waveguide (69-112GHz) Output Ports
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Two photonic millimeter-wave synthesizers based upon optical heterodyning are presented. A photonic synthesizer with coaxial W1 output for operation from DC-110GHz and a synthesizer featuring a rectangular WR10 waveguide output for signal generation from 69-112GHz are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Simple Low-cost Homodyne PSK Receiver
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel phase shift keying (PSK) receiver technique is proposed based on electronic-driven diversity and same optics than heterodyne. It achieves high tolerance to phase noise and feasible implementation with offthe- shelf electronic and optical components.

articleTitle: A Method to Use Continuous Mode Receivers as Burst Mode Receivers for TDM-based Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a very simple, but very effective, method to drastically reduce the dynamic range requirement of the burst-mode receiver for TDM-based passive optical networks. Its feasibility is demonstrated with a 2.5Gb/s continuous mode receiver.

articleTitle: Electronic Mitigation Robustness to the combined effect of CD and second order PMD
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The robustness of electronic mitigation to Second Order PMD and CD is experimentally assessed. We quantify their combined impact and identify the (PMD, CD) domain over which SOPMD impact can not be neglected anymore.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wide-Band Low Loss and High Reliability Polymer Optical Waveguide
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated polymer optical waveguide with propagation loss comparable to silica, and with high reliability.Propagation loss was 0.022dB/cm at 1550nm. Damp heat and high power tests gave very good results.

articleTitle: Suppressing dynamic instabilities in PMD compensators by dithering the polarization of the transmitted signal
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Dynamical issues of practical PMD compensators can be eliminated by modulating the polarization of the transmitted signal. Low-depth modulation (dithering) stabilizes the compensator whilst not introducing significant jitter nor eye closure.

articleTitle: High Speed Transmission Technologies for 100-Gbit/s-class Ethernet
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper gives an overview of recent 100-Gbit/s transmission experiments and reviews enabling technologies for the realization of single-channel 100 Gbit/s Ethernet.

articleTitle: Calculation of Raman Fiber Laser Spectra by a Combination of Shooting Method and Split-Step Fourier Transform Algorithm
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A numerical method for calculation of FWM spectral broadening in Raman fiber lasers is presented. It is based on the steady-state equations and the nonlinear Schrdinger equation. Numerical results are confirmed by measurements.

articleTitle: Equalized 42.8 Gb/s Transmission Based on a 10Gb/s EML Transmitter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A low cost 10 Gb/s electro-absorption modulated laser was directly driven by 42.8Gb/s data stream and matched by electronic equalization performed at the receiver to achieve OC-768 transmission. We demonstrate an uncompensated OC-768 reach of 21 km over standard single mode fiber.

articleTitle: Refractive Index Sensor Based on Whispering Gallery Modes Resonances of Thin Capillaries
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Whispering gallery modes resonances of thin capillaries shift as a function of the refractive index of the liquids that fill the inside, with very high sensitivity, and enable the measure of relatively high index values.

articleTitle: Large-scale AWG Router (15 nodes, 217 paths) Providing Full-mesh and Non-uniform Transmission Capacities
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed an AWG router with non-uniform transmission capacities realizing the best wavelength utilization. The router has a cyclic routing table and its throughput is extended to about three times that of the previous one.

articleTitle: The Status of POF Technology
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Plastic optical fiber (POF) has been established in unique datacom markets such as digital audio interfaces, factory automations and automotive LANs. Low-loss graded index POF has opened a new market of customer premises network in recent years. The status of POF technology towards broadband network is reviewed.

articleTitle: High Performance SCM Optical Packet Switching Router for Optical Circuit, Burst and Variable Length Packet Processing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An optical subcarrier multiplexing packet switching router based on the label swapping paradigm supporting optical burst switching and optical circuit switching connections at 10 Gb/s on a single platform is presented.

articleTitle: Fast Optical Clock Recovery and Signal Regeneration Applications of a Monolithic Mode Locked Laser with DBR Mirrors and an Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate optical packet clock recovery with locking in less than 700 ps (25 bits) using a novel device which is compatible with other monolithic components. Regenerative capabilities are analyzed using bit error rate tests.

articleTitle: Actively Mode-Locked Fabry-Perot Laser Diode Module for Sampling Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on a Fabry-Perot laser diode packaged in a module compatible with active mode-locking. We obtained narrow pulses (2ps) with an ultra-low level jitter (<200fs) at 17GHz, this is compatble with optical sampling applications.

articleTitle: MIXSELs - a new class of ultrafast semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: For the first time we have successfully demonstrated a novel concept of a passively modelocked vertical-external-cavity surface-emitting semiconductor laser with an integrated saturable absorber. This MIXSEL will be ultimately suitable for cost-effective high-volume wafer-scale fabrication.

articleTitle: Impact of Fiber Chromatic Dispersion on DS-OCDMA System
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A criterion, fmaxLmaxD=10(exp 2), is proposed to judge the maximum fiber access distance, within which chromatic dispersion can be neglected. And it is verified by a 22 DS-OCDMA system at 127-chip 320-Gchip/s.

articleTitle: Wavelength Converter with +5 dB Parametric Gain Using Direct-Bonded QPM-Zn: LiNbO3 Ridge Waveguide
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We fabricate a 50-mm-long ZnO-doped quasi-phase-matched LiNbO3 ridge waveguide by employing the direct bonding and dry etching techniques. We successfully achieve a parametric conversion gain of +5 dB by using a chi(2) cascade scheme.

articleTitle: Optical Properties of Highly Al2O3 and P2O5 Doped Silica Hosts for Large Mode Area Fiber Lasers and Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Highly Al2O3 and P2O5-doped silica glass having a low refractive index has been studied. Compositions providing loss below 30dB/km and therefore suitable as hosts in LMA active fibers have been determined.

articleTitle: Novel Dispersion Compensating Module based Interrogator for Fiber Bragg Grating Sensors
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel interrogator for fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensors using a dispersion compensating module. High speed potential of this scheme has also been investigated.

articleTitle: Scalable all-optical packet-switching nodes: a dimensioning study
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: All-optical Label Swapping suffers from bad scalability. This paper proposes a new AOLS node design based on wavelength striping. It compares the new design with the original AOLS node via a dimensioning study.

articleTitle: 160Gb/s characterisation of gain and phase dynamics of a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report the first characterisation of nonlinear gain, phase and chirp dynamics of an SOA at 160Gb/s using a spectrogram measurement technique. Results are key for the design of 160Gb/s optical SOA-based wavelength converters.

articleTitle: Spurious Free Dynamic Range of 1.3 micrometer and 850 nm Directly Modulated High Speed VCSELs for Low Cost WLAN-over-Fibre Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The nonlinearity and RIN of 1.3micrometer and 850nm VCSELs were evaluated at the 2.4/5.8GHz bands to investigate their viability for WLAN-over-fibre systems. More than 38km single mode and 300m multimode reach can be achieved.

articleTitle: Dispersionless Slow Light with 5-Pulse-Width Delay in a Long Fibre Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We observe the excitation of gap solitons in a 30 cm fibre Bragg grating using 0.68 ns pulses, which emerge with a tunable delay of up to 3.2 ns, or almost 5 pulse widths, without broadening.

articleTitle: All-Optical RZ-DPSK WDM to RZ-DQPSK Phase Multiplexing using Four-Wave Mixing in Highly-Nonlinear Fiber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-optical phase multiplexing scheme using FWM in a highlynonlinear fiber. Two 10-Gb/s RZ-DPSK WDM signals are phase-multiplexed into one 20-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signal with a 1.6-dB negative power penalty.

articleTitle: Impact of Nonlinear Spectral Broadening on the Efficiency of Ultra-Long Raman Fiber Laser Transmission Links
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We study the impact of nonlinear spectral broadening in ultra-long Raman laser cavities up to a record length of 82 km, and its implications for the design of quasi-lossless spans for signal transmission and processing.

articleTitle: Sub-Band-Patch-Through heuristic for cost efficient wavelength assignment in DWDM networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper discusses a heuristic for cost efficient wavelength assignment by saving mux/demux cards at nodes in an all-optical network while using the possibility to patch through wavelengths of a sub-band at intermediate nodes.

articleTitle: Performance of Electronic Predistortion Systems with 1 Sample/bit Processing using Optical Duobinary Format
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show that EPD using optical duobinary allows reduced sampling rates and increased dispersion tolerance. We report results of simulations of 10.7Gb/s transmission over 800km of SSMF with <2dB OSNR penalty using 1 sample/bit DACs.

articleTitle: Status and recent results from the POF-ALL EU project: large-core plastic fibers for low cost, high-speed short reach applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present an overview of the EU STREP project POF-ALL, aimed at developing new low-cost high-speed short reach optical transmission systems based on large-core Plastic Optical Fibers (POF).

articleTitle: Low-Penalty Transmission of High-Speed Data through a Cascade of Silicon Microring Resonator Drop Ports
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate the propagation of 10-Gb/s optical data through a cascade of microring filter drop ports. The power penalty is measured through two and four resonator hops and compared with simulated values.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Wavelength-Shared Hybrid Passive Optical Network Upgrade Re-using Both Optical Network Units and Remote Node
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have proposed and demonstrated the cost-effectiveness of a Wavelength-Shared Hybrid PON architecture for upgrades of existing PON systems while re-using all equipment on customer premises and reusing the fiber plant including remote node.

articleTitle: Low Cost and High Performance Fibre In-line Bi-directional Optical Subassembly for Fibre-to-the-Home
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a novel fibre in-line bi-directional optical subassembly (BOSA) based on core-to-cladding mode coupling. We successfully demonstrated 10km transmission using proposed BOSA which has 1.76GHz 3dB bandwidth , -23.6dBm sensitivity, and -86dB crosstalk.

articleTitle: Carrier Phase Control for FWM Cross-talk Suppression in Dense WDM Transmission at Low-Dispersion Wavelength
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: FWM crosstalk distortion can be suppressed by controlling the relative phase of WDM carriers. Calculation and experiments show that WDM carrier phase control suppresses the in-phase component of FWM lights and reduces signal degradation.

articleTitle: A Novel Signaling Protocol for Fast Lightpath Setup in GMPLS/WDM Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose an efficient signaling protocol for GMPLS/WDM optical networks based on backward reservation protocol. The simulation results show that the proposed protocol reduces setup time, number of reservation conflicts, and the blocking probability.

articleTitle: A lambda/4-shifted Distributed Feedback Semiconductor Fiber Ring Laser with an OSNR of 85 dB and a Linewidth of 7 kHz
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We newly propose a lambda/4-shifted DFB semiconductor fiber ring laser incorporating an ultranarrow band FBG in the cavity. Large performance improvements with an OSNR of 85 dB and a linewidth of 7 kHz are obtained.

articleTitle: Acoustically Q-switched single-frequency fibre laser
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present an actively Q-switched DFB fibre laser. An acoustic pulse traveling along a fibre grating written in Er-doped fibre generates a dynamic defect that makes the DFB laser to operate in pulsed regime.

articleTitle: Continuous-Wave Supercontinuum-Based Bidirectional Long Reach WDM-POM Incorporating FP-LD-based OLT and RSOA-based ONUs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a long reach (60km), bidirectional, colorless WDM-PON architecture based on uncooled, TO-can packaged RSOAs for upstream and FP-LDs for downstream, which are wavelengthlocked by a spectrum-sliced, high power, depolarised CW supercontinuum injection source.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum generation with 532 nm quasi-continuum pulses in photonic crystal fibre tapers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report experimental results on supercontinuum generation in PCF tapers using quasi-continuous pump pulses of 7 ns duration at 532 nm. SC generation in normal and anomalous dispersion regimes are presented.

articleTitle: 100Gbit/s packet generation with spectral efficiency larger than 1bit/Hz/s by using optical carrier suppression and separation and vestigial sideband
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated how to generate 100Gbit/s packet signals with spectral efficiency higher than 1bit/Hz/s for the first time. The performance of transmission and label erasure has also been evaluated.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s Transmission at 1.55micrometer with Directly Modulated Quantum Dash Laser and Constant Operation Parameters up to 85 deg C
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: 10Gb/s transmission at 1.55micrometer up to 85 deg C is realise d with a quantum dash directly modulated laser. The bias current and current swing are unchanged during operation, demonstrating a temperature independent modulated light source.

articleTitle: All-optical NRZ-DPSK Clock Recovery Using Chirped Fibre Bragg Grating (CFBG) Induced Clock Tone
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: All-optical NRZ-DPSK clock recovery is demonstrated with the CFBG induced clock tone and SOAbased fibre ring laser. The 10 GHz clock is optically recovered with 17 dB extinction ratio and 540 fs root-meansquare timing jitter.

articleTitle: 1310/1550 nm SMF-FSO-SMF Transmission without Intermediate O/E Conversion using Automatic Optical-Axis Alignment Method
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We designed a bidirectional transmission system in which a single-mode optical fiber line and a freespace optics line are directly connected without photoelectric devices. 1 Gbit/s transmissions at 1310 and 1550 nm wavelengths were successfully achieved with 5 Hz vibration using an automatic optical axis alignment method.

articleTitle: End-to-end synchronous digital television distribution using IP multicast and RF overlay hybrid techniques
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Digital television signal distribution over IP and RF overlay GE-PON networks was successfully demonstrated. Extraordinary end-to-end synchronization with IP packet jitter suppression and precise clockrecovery for OFDM television signals is confirmed.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Ultra-Compact Highly Nonlinear Fibers and Their Applications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In this paper, we review design and characteristics of recently reported down-sized highly nonlinear fibers (HNLFs) and ultra-compact HNLF modules. A Certain feasibility of down-sized HNLFs is confirmed through optical and mechanical evaluation. Furthermore, not only down-sizing, new attractive application is realized by utilizing unique mechanical characteristics of down-sized HNLF.

articleTitle: Experimental interconnection and interworking of the multi-domain (ASON-GMPLS) and multi-layer (TDM-LSC) NOBEL2 test-beds
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper presents the implemented interconnection of the test-beds involved in NOBEL2 project based on a star-hub router, and the proposed solution for ASON-GMPLS multi-domain multi-layer interworking among test-beds based on a centralized ASON-GMPLS proxy.

articleTitle: Investigation of Waveguide Mode Profile Using Low Coherent Interferometric Method
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate for the first time a waveguide mode profile characterization scheme in an AWG, utilizing low coherent interferometric measurement. The technique is very effective in characterizing input waveguide design in advanced AWG devices.

articleTitle: Paced TCP gives higher utilization with no buffers than with small buffers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Using a new analytical model of TCP link utilization, we show that paced TCP achieves better utilization when the bottleneck routers have no buffers rather than small buffers.

articleTitle: Temperature dependence of Henry factor of Undoped and p-doped InAs/GaAs Quantum-Dot Lasers emitting at 1.3 micrometer
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The temperature dependence of Henry factor aH of undoped and p-type doped InAs/GaAs QD lasers is reported for the 20-80 deg C range. It is shown that aH of p-type doped devices is temperature insensitive.

articleTitle: A Novel WDN-PON Using Simultaneously Generated DPSK and OOK Centralized Lightwaves for Future Multi-Services in Access Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrated a novel multi-services WDM-PON system by using centralized lightwave sources. The service provision with 10Gb/s OOK and DPSK downstream signals and 1.25Gb/s upstream data has been successfully realized.

articleTitle: A novel bidirectional WDM/TDM-PON using DPSK downstream signals and a custom AWG
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate a novel SOA-based bidirectional WDM/TDM-PON architecture that exploits a custom- AWG for distribution and demodulation of all WDM-NRZ-DPSK downstream signals and a Reflective-SOA to remodulate the 1Gbit/s upstream signal.

articleTitle: Large Aeff NZ-DSF with dispersion slope of 0.02 ps/nm2/km by utilizing Restrict-Mode-Excitation method
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Large Aeff NZ-DSFs with Aeff larger than 65 mm2 and dispersion slope of 0.02 ps/nm2/km were successfully fabricated by utilizing Restrict Mode Excitation method. The pure single mode pulse transmission was experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: Lambda Sharing Demonstration via Traffic-Driven Lambda-on-Demand
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper proposes GMPLS-capable Lambda-on-Demand to adjust the number of load-balanced endto- end lambdas according to the traffic volume while successfully sharing lambda resources to connect between any two of three nodes for the first time.

articleTitle: Compact Waveguide Array Connectors for Optical Backplane System
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Novel backplane connectors are demonstrated. Using 3D-waveguide arrays with optical path redirection, multiple optical fibers can be simultaneously plugged into the backplane connector. Furthermore, modulation performance of a 10-Gbps/ch eye opening is successfully obtained.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Demodulation and Slow-light Delay of DPSK Signals at Flexible Bit-Rates Using Bandwidth-Tunable SBS in Optical Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Simultaneous demodulation and slow-light delay of 10-Gb/s and 2.5-Gb/s DPSK signals with excellent performance are demonstrated using bandwidth-tunable SBS in optical fibre. SBS demodulation presents much better delay performance compared with 1-bit-delay demodulation.

articleTitle: A Fast-Response and High-Sensitivity PIN-TIA Module with Wide Dynamic Range for 10G Burst-Mode Transmissions
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A 10G burst-mode PIN-TIA module has been developed with a new function of automatic offset compensation. An instantaneous response of 10 ns, high sensitivity of -19.5 dBm, and a wide dynamic range of 20.5 dB were obtained.

articleTitle: Unrepeatered Transmission of 160 Gb/s RZ-DPSK over 240 km Dispersion Managed Fiber
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The advantages of using RZ-DPSK in combination with Raman amplification and advanced forwarderror- correction are shown in an OTDM-transmission experiment of a 160 Gb/s single-polarization signal over an unrepeatered distance of 240 km.

articleTitle: Optically Gain-clamped EDFAs in Dynamic Burst Switched Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The impact of network size on optical feedback cavity design in optically gain-clamped EDFAs for the suppression of power transients is investigated using a recirculation loop based dynamic optical network testbed.

articleTitle: Seamless and Cost-effective Upgrade from G-PON to 10G-PON by Dual-rate Mixture PON System using Electrical Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a dual-rate mixture PON system using electrical multiplexing on G-PON wavelengths. By introducing a downstream synch-protection mapping and an over-sampling algorithm, we comply with G-PON Class-B+ performance and demonstrate seamless upgrade of 10G-PON.

articleTitle: AllOptical Envelope Detection for Wireless Photonic Communication
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate operation of an all-optical half-wave rectifier to implement all-optical envelope detection for photonic wireless communication. Down-conversion of a 38 GHz, 3.25 Gb/s ASK, radio frequency signal is successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Inscription of zone plate pattern on the optical fiber end surface using femtosecond laser pulses
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We fabricated a compact fiber based zone plate on the coreless-silica-fiber (CSF) segments of 200micrometer diameter by femtosecond laser. We investigated the focusing properties by launching a He-Ne laser beam into the optical fiber.

articleTitle: Dynamic capacity allocation for low-cost multicarrier multimode PON
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A stable-matching-based multiuser multicarrier capacity allocation algorithm is proposed. It responds to ONU backlogs and dynamic subchannel gains. Benchmarked against Binary Linear Programming, it results in just 5% less allocated capacity, at much lower complexity.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of 40-Gbit/s Operation of a Semiconductor- Integrated Optical Digital-to-Analog Converter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrated the first operation of a 40-Gbit/s semiconductor-integrated optical digital-to-analog converter. Four-level signals were generated and a quarter dependence of phase on temperature and wavelength compared with that for 10-Gbit/s was verified.

articleTitle: AOLS node with sequential address generation and label recognition
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper proposes an all-optical counter, built out of MZI switches. Due to the counter, all-optical labels can be checked sequentially. A dimensioning study shows how it improves the AOLS nodes scalability.

articleTitle: Development of New Optical Access Network System Based on Optical Packet Switches
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper presents the development of a downstream-side system for the Gigabit Ethernet-Optical Switched Access Network (GE-OSAN). We detail two of the technologies required by the system: optical packet switching and optical burst receiving.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 960 Gb/s (96 x 12.3 Gb/s) Transpacific OADM Network in a Re-Circulating Single-Loop Transmission Experiment
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present the first laboratory demonstration of transoceanic OADM networks. Using a new method for study of networks in re-circulating single-loop transmission experiments, we demonstrate successful transpacific 96x12.3Gb/s DWDM-networking, including transmission over various OADM branches.

articleTitle: A Fiber-Based All-Optical Regenerator for DQPSK Signals
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Analysis of an all-optical 3R regenerator for DQPSK signals is presented. The phase regeneration is performed in the amplitude domain by the use of fiber-based 2R regenerator. Reduction of phase noise is achievable by strong amplitude regeneration.

articleTitle: Highly Spectral Efficiency Multi-User Optical Network Architecture using 1-Gb/s 16QAM Subcarrier Multiplexing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A proof-of-principal-demonstration of a 20-Gb/s multi-user optical network using SCM-16QAM for high spectral-efficiency is reported. A single wavelength 20-SCM channel simulation is performed, showing an EVM of less than 7% for the worst case channel.

articleTitle: Design of ultimate gain-flattened broadband O, E, and S+C+L fiber amplifiers by a new fiber Raman gain medium
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: By solving the inverse amplifier design problem, gain-flattened broadband O (~17.5 THz), E (~15.1 THz), and S+C+L (~20.9 THz) fiber Raman amplifiers are designed by a new TeO2-BaO-SrO-Nb2O5-P2O5-WO3 (TBSNWP) tellurite fiber.

articleTitle: Broadband Dispersion Compensating Hole-Assisted Fibers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel design of a broadband dispersion compensating hole-assisted fiber is demonstrated numerically. The proposed structure exhibits the largest negative dispersion of -552ps/nm/km at 1550nm with matched RDS. Further, its Raman amplification properties are investigated.

articleTitle: The role of birefringence correlation in spun fiber PMD properties
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show that the autocorrelation function of fiber birefringence may play a crucial role in the definition of spun fiber PMD properties, to the extend that for certain autocorrelation the spin may even increase PMD.

articleTitle: Fibre-independent Dispersion-Map Optimization for the Suppression of XPM and SPM in Fibre-Optical Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a procedure to optimize successively the dispersion map of a 10 Gb/s WDM NRZ system by adjusting the residual dispersion per span, the net residual dispersion, and pre-compensation. The method is based on the evaluation of nonlinear phase shifts and accumulated dispersion along the transmission line.

articleTitle: All-Optical 20 Gb/s Logic AND Gate with Tunable Single-Channel Output or Dual-Channel Outputs Using a PPLN waveguide
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate at 20 Gb/s a novel logic AND gate using cascaded sum- and differencefrequency generation in a periodically poled LiNbO3 waveguide. Tunable single-channel output and dual-channel outputs are observed in the experiment.

articleTitle: PLC-type demultiplexer with a spectral modulation function
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report a 100-GHz-spacing 48-channel PLC-type demultiplexer with a wavelength monitoring function composed of an MZI and two AWGs. Its transmission spectra can be shifted at a practical rate by modulating the MZI section.

articleTitle: Access Network Technologies: Deployments in Sweden
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Access network technologies are discussed in the context of Swedish deployments. Sweden is characterised by a high penetration of FTTH. The most common technology is point-to-point Ethernet, either as a L2 or as a L3 solution.

articleTitle: Analysis of Wavelength Blocking in Large Metro Core Network Using Optical and Digital ROADM Transport Systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Network planning analysis indicates wavelength blocking in all-optical ROADM networks incurs additional OEO for wavelength conversion, and constrains service reconfiguration. Analyses show that digital ROADM systems mitigate these problems and may provide greater service flexibility.

articleTitle: Electronics and photonics: convergence on a silicon platform
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The complete integration of photonic devices into a CMOS process flow will enable low cost photonic functionality within electronic circuits. We will discuss challenges and opportunities for CMOS integrated photonic devices.

articleTitle: Soliton Self-frequency Shift based Slow Light in Optical Fiber up to 1600 Delay-to-pulse-width Ratio
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have proposed an all-optical tunable delay line using soliton self-frequency shift and filtering supercontinuum spectrum. A wide range tunability up to 1600 delay-to-pulse-width ratio for 0.45ps pulse was demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Optical signal quality monitoring using fibre-Bragg-grating-based correlators in optical packet-switched networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel technique based on the use of optical pulse correlation to assess the signal quality at the optical domain with relaxed speed requirements is proposed. The method is compared to traditional techniques based on BER estimation.

articleTitle: Improving the Transmission Performance for an Externally Modulated Baseband Single Sideband OFDM Signal Using Nonlinear Post-compensation and
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose the nonlinear post-compensation and differential encoding schemes for an externally modulated optical baseband SSB OFDM signal. We show the tolerance to the chromatic dispersion could be effectively enlarged by the differential detection technique.

articleTitle: MINCOD-MTD: A RWA Algorithm in Semi-Transparent Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
