abstract: This paper proposes a new RWA algorithm that takes into consideration the Maximum Transmission Distance (MTD) parameter to be applied to semi-transparent optical networks, achieving a considerable benefit in terms of blocking probability reduction.

articleTitle: Broadband SBS Slow Light using Simple Spectrally-Sliced Pumping
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate broadband SBS slow-light using spectrally-sliced pumping. Both 2.5-Gb/s NRZ-OOK and NRZ-DPSK signals are delayed by maximum 170-ps with 4-dB power-penalty. Periodic spectrally-sliced multi-channel pumping scheme is proposed within a single slow-light medium.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Chromatic Dispersion and Optical Noise insensitivity of a Quantum-Dash based Fabry-Perot Laser in All-optical Clock Recovery at 40
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In this paper we propose BER measurements allowing to demonstrate the ultra-low sensitivity of an all-optical clock recovery on a quantum-dash Fabry-Perot Laser to chromatic dispersion and optical noise on the injected data signal.

articleTitle: 10/2.5Gbps Demonstration in Extra-Large PON Prototype
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We describe the concept, realization and tests of a full-functional prototype for a future extra-large passive optical network. 10Gbps downstream and 2.5Gbps burst-mode upstream traffic at 100km reach and 1:512 split was achieved.

articleTitle: Location and temporal characterization of hinges in optical fiber links
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A reflectometric technique for the location and characterization of hinges in PMD-affected optical fiber links is presented. Preliminary laboratory tests confirm the viability and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of Deflection Routing in a 3-Node Optical Burst Core Network with 40Gb/s Edge Nodes
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate deflection routing for random burst collision in a 3-node optical burst switching network testbed. Using a Ether-frame capable burst edge node, layer 2 characterization was performed, with neartheoretical low frame error at 40Gb/s.

articleTitle: Distributed Birefringence Measurement in Optical Fibers with Ultra-High Spatial Resolution by Brillouin Gain Analysis
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Distributed birefringence measurement in optical fibers with ultra-high resolution of a few centimeters is proposed and demonstrated by Brillouin gain analysis with the optical correlation method. Local changes of polarization axes can also be detected.

articleTitle: Timing jitter tolerant 640 Gb/s demultiplexing using a long-period fibre grating-based flat-top pulse shaper
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A 400 fs flat-top pulse is used to demultiplex a 640 Gb/s data signal with a significant increase in jitter tolerance to 350 fs, and a substantial reduction in receiver sensitivity penalty.

articleTitle: Novel Technique for PMD Measurements of Installed Fibers Using Random Polarization Scrambling and a Tunable OTDR
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel field-practical technique for single-end PMD measurement in an optical fiber, based on randomly polarized launched and detected light pulses, is significantly less sensitive to cable movement and offers improved measurement precision.

articleTitle: Passive All-optical Clock Recovery demonstration at 42.66 Gbit/s with Bragg-gratings based Fabry-Perot Filter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: In this paper, we present the performance of an all-optical clock recovery device based on a passive Fabry-Perot band-pass filter made-up of Bragg Gratings and followed by an SOA for patterning effect reduction.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Rare-Earth Doped Fibers by Flash Vaporization Method
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Highly rare-earth doped optical fiber preforms were produced using flash vaporization method for precursor delivery. TEOS and lanthanide precursors were used. Preforms with fully consolidated core layers have been made and were drawn to fibers.

articleTitle: Demonstration and analysis of TV- and data transport in the OpMiGua hybrid circuit/packet switched network testbed
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: TV-broadcast distribution and contribution are important optical network applications requiring absolute performance guarantees. We demonstrate the OpMiGua testbed for uncompressed IP-videostreaming in the presence of standard IP data transport in the network.

articleTitle: An interoperable access network based on CWDM-routed PONs
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A dynamic access network architecture based on coarse-routed PONs is described. Modelling of a coarse-AWG OLT to support multiple RSOA-based ONUs has demonstrated error-free transmission in the presence of AWG polarisation-dependent wavelength shift and phase-errors.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Dispersion Compensation by Optical Phase Conjugation in Silicon Waveguide
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate dispersion compensation using a silicon based optical phase conjugator for simultaneous transmission of 4 DWDM channels of 10 Gb/s optical data over 320 km of standard fiber with negligible power penalty.

articleTitle: 40 Gbit/s Directly Modulated Passive Feedback Laser with Complex-Coupled DFB Section
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: 40 Gbit/s open eyes are demonstrated for a passive feedback laser transmitter with complex coupled DFB section. The transmitter shows superior single mode emission in combination with chirp tuning capability and high reliability.

articleTitle: Phase Noise on Coherent Optical OFDM Systems with 16-QAM and 64-QAM beyond 10 Gb/s
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present the experimental transmission results of coherent optical OFDM systems with 16-QAM and 64-QAM formats. Phase noise effects from laser linewidth and non-linear fibre transmission are investigated.

articleTitle: 320 Gbit/s Simultaneous Clock Recovery and Channel Identification
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on a cross-phase modulation-based scheme for simultaneous channel identification and prescaled clock recovery for high-speed data transmission.

articleTitle: Planning of GMPLS Transport Networks With Conversion and Regeneration Capabilities
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose heuristics that are capable of planning large-sized GMPLS transport networks with conversion and regeneration capabilities in a reasonable amount of time. The planning problem objective is to minimize the total weighted port count.

articleTitle: Enlargement of PMD tolerance in 43 Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK signal using electrical dispersion compensation without adaptive control
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We describe the enlargement of PMD tolerance using EDC without adaptive control numerically and demonstrate the effectiveness in a 43 Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK transmission experiment. The tolerance was extended to over 30 ps.

articleTitle: Vertically Coupled GaInAsP/InP Microring Lasers Fabricated by Using Full Wafer Bonding
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We summarize results on the processing and characterization of current injected 1.55 micrometer single- and multi-microring lasers including vertical active/passive waveguide coupling. The devices were fabricated by GaInAsP/InP-GaAs full-wafer bonding using a BCB interface.

articleTitle: Simple Node Architectures for Concatenation of ROADM Rings
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose simplified node architectures for connecting two ROADM rings. The necessary switch scale can be reduced (50-90%) compared to the conventional approach. A novel optical switching node architecture and the MUX/DEMUX are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Electrical PMD Compensation in 43-Gb/s POLMUX-NRZ-DQPSK enabled by Coherent Detection and Equalization
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: PMD compensation using coherent equalization is demonstrated experimentally. Using 43-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed NRZ-DQPSK, we show compensation of practically arbitrary amounts of DGD (>200ps) and CD with negligible penalty, even in the presence of PDL and SOPMD.

articleTitle: Transpacific Ethernet Transport over GMPLS-based Three Administrative-Domain Photonic Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper describes the results of transpacific light path creation for an Ethernet transport service over GMPLS-controlled three administrative domain networks between the US and Japan. Routing problems that arose in the multiple-domain network was successfully solved and the actual service activation time of Ethernet transport services was evaluated for the first time.

articleTitle: Simple ROF configuration to simultaneously realize optical millimeter-wave signal generation and source-free base station operation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have proposed and experimentally demonstrated one novel and simple scheme to generate optical mmwave signals and realize source-free base station operation by using directed modulation laser and optical filter techniques.

articleTitle: Integrated devices for all-optical signal processing
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Hybrid integration of semiconductor optical amplifiers into practical all-optical signal processing modules is described. Recent advances in nonlinear SOAs and multiple array devices are highlighted, with applications from optical memory to sophisticated burst-mode optical regenerators.

articleTitle: A cost-effective scheme to generate and de-multiplex multiple frequency millimeter-wave signals in a ROF network
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A novel scheme to generate multiple frequency millimeter (mm)-wave signals is achieved by imposing two RF carriers onto one optical carrier by employing only one external modulator. Demultiplexing with lowcrosstalk for the multiple frequency mm-wave signals has also been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Observation of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering in Ultrahigh-speed In-phase and Carrier-suppressed RZ OTDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report that stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) plays an important role in ultrahigh-speed bitwise phase-controlled OTDM transmission such as in-phase and carrier-suppressed RZ. SBS-induced performance limitation in a 160 Gbit/s-500 km transmission is described.

articleTitle: Characterisation of an RZ-DQPSK transmitter using coherent detection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We characterise the optical field from an RZ-DQPSK transmitter using coherently detected constellation diagrams. We show the dependence on bias and phase offsets, as well as timing mismatch.

articleTitle: Ultrafast Waveguide-integrated pin-Photodiodes and Photonic Mixers from GHz to THz Range
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Long-wavelength InP-based micro-pin photodiodes with 150 GHz bandwidth are demonstrated. Applying these diodes optically parallel-fed travelling wave photodetectors with high output power and photonic mixer sub-THz transmitter ICs will be demonstrated.

articleTitle: State-Complexity Reduction in MLSD Receivers for Direct-Detection Optical Communications
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate the impact of state complexity reduction techniques on the performance of MLSD-based EDC. Our results show that simple state reduction techniques guarantee a good trade-off between complexity and robustness against uncompensated chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: A bidirectional Single Sideband Gigabit WDM-RoF System using Reflective SOA
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We proposed a new bidirectional gigabit wavelength division multiplexed-radio on fiber (WDM-RoF) system which shares the same wavelength. Central station for downlink transmits the 30GHz single sideband wireless signal which is modulated 1.25Gb/s by use of a mach-zehnder modulator and a fiber bragg grating. Base station for uplink transmits 1.25Gb/s wireless signal using a reflective semiconductor optical amplifier. We achieved a BER<10-9 of downlink at -14.05dBm and uplink at -18.9dBm after 20km transmission.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of DQPSK using Pseudo-Random Quaternary Sequences
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present performance assessments of optical communications systems employing DQPSK modulation format and pseudo-random multi-level data sequences of various lengths. Differences to simulation results based on pseudo-random binary sequences will be pointed out and discussed.

articleTitle: Multi-Channel Operation of a Receiver Photonic Integrated Circuit with an Integrated Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate mutli-channel operation of a high speed, dense wavelength division multiplexed (DWDM), InP receiver photonic integrated circuits with on-chip semiconductor optical amplifiers

articleTitle: All-Optical Half-Adder by Using a Single-Stage Optical Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An all-optical half-adder has been successfully demonstrated using cross gain modulation (XGM) and four-wave mixing (FWM) in an optical parametric amplifier (OPA) on a highly-nonlinear dispersion-shifted fiber. Power penalty of less than 2dB was achieved.

articleTitle: Dither-free, Accurate, and Robust Phase Offset Monitor and Control Method for Optical DQPSK Demodulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A dither-free phase offset monitor and control method for an optical DQPSK demodulator is proposed. The phase offset is controlled with better than 1 degree accuracy and Q-penalty below 0.1 dB for 43 Gb/s.

articleTitle: Demonstration of C- and L-band external cavity wavelength tunable laser utilizing a wideband SOA with coupled quantum well active layer
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We have developed a wideband SOA as gain chip of a C+L band tunable laser by introducing coupled QWs. Low threshold current deviation, over 13-dBm fiber coupled power, and high SMSR across a 77-nm tuning range were demonstrated.

articleTitle: Pattern Effect Removal Technique for Semiconductor Optical Amplifier-Based Wavelength Conversion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A technique to overcome pattern effects due to slow recovery times in SOA based wavelength converters is presented. It uses the superposition of the outputs of red-shifted and blue-shifted filters having complementary pattern effects.

articleTitle: Theoretical Performance Limits Limits of Optical DPSK Under Severe Chromatic Dispersion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate the theoretical performance limits, in terms of information rate, of optical DPSK. In particular, we characterize the chromatic dispersion tolerance of DPSK. For comparison, the performance of MLSD is also considered.

articleTitle: Single MZI-based 1x4 DQPSK demodulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a newly developed planar lightwave circuit (PLC) type 1x4 DQPSK demodulator, which has simply designed 90deg-hybrid. We also demonstrate a low insertion loss and excellent 43 Gbps demodulation characteristics.

articleTitle: Measurement of Constellation Diagrams for 40-Gb/s DQPSK and 60- Gb/s 8ary-DPSK Using Sampled Orthogonal Differential Direct-Detection
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate the reconstruction of constellation diagrams for 40-Gb/s DQPSK and 60-Gb/s 8ary- DPSK signals using orthogonal differential direct-detection and analog-to-digital conversion. The recovered differential-phase variance manifests various transmission impairments including noise and fiber nonlinearity.

articleTitle: 8-channel 200 GHz-Spacing Multi-Wavelength Lasers by Silica PLC Hybrid Integration
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We successfully fabricated a very compact 8-channel 200 GHz-spacing multi-wavelength laser (MWL) module for WDM-PON OLT source. The wavelength shift of MWL from ITU grid was within - 0.25nm for the 8- channels, which was well matched to target wavelength shift of less than 0.2nm. This module operates successfully with a total throughput of 1.25 Gbit/s over 20 Km transmission.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Task-flow based Aircraft Collaborative Design Application in Optical Grid
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: One task-flow scheduler has been designed to optimally allocate resources for a task-flow based Aircraft Collaborative Design Application in Optical Grid. This scheduler and application has been deployed on an Optical Grid testbed. The applications practical running demonstrates its feasibility.

articleTitle: Impact of Inter-Channel Nonlinearities on 10-Gbaud NRZ-DQPSK WDM Transmission over Raman Amplified NZDSF Spans
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We show that inter-channel cross-phase modulation (XPM) significantly reduces the performance of a 10-Gbaud differential-quadrature-phase-shift-keying (DQPSK) WDM transmission system, and nonlinear polarization scattering causes further performance degradation when polarization division multiplexing is applied.

articleTitle: Highly Sensitive Coherent Optical Frequency-domain Reflectometry Employing SSB-modulator with cm-level Spatial Resolution over 5 km
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present OFDR employing an SSB-modulator and a narrow linewidth fibre-laser. We achieved cmlevel resolution over 5 km measurement range and high sensitivity with a noise level 23 dB lower than the Rayleigh backscatter level.

articleTitle: A 100 Gbps Flexible Optoelectronic Interconnection with Multi-Mode Optical Waveguide Circuits
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed a 100 Gbps bandwidth (12.5 Gbps/ch x 8 ch) flexible optoelectronic interconnection with electrical circuits and 40 um core multi-mode optical waveguide circuits. The electrical circuits work for not only electrical interconnections but also electrodes for wiring the optical devices and buffer ICs.

articleTitle: Impairment tolerance of 111Gbit/s POLMUX-RZ-DQPSK using a reduced complexity coherent receiver with a T-spaced equaliser
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The tolerance to narrow spectral filtering in presence of chromatic dispersion is investigated for 111Gbit/s POLMUX-RZ-DQPSK. It is shown that the use of T-spaced equalisers is enabled by appropriate electrical filtering.

articleTitle: Optical network architecture for UWB range extension beyond a single complex of cells
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present an efficient scenario for deploying high-capacity optical access networks using Radio over Fibre technology. A wide range of interactive multimedia services are available to end-users by using latestgeneration, ultra wideband radio signalling methodology.

articleTitle: Multi-period NOLM design for ultrafast all-optical A/D conversion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Targeting 100-GS/s, 4-bit A/D conversion, design consideration of NOLM having multi-period transfer function is presented. A NOLM with nearly 4-period transfer function for 2-ps sampled pulses is experimentally demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution over WDMs and optical switches to combine the quantum channel with synchronization channels
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We use standard CWDM-telecom equipment and optical switches to combine entangled photons with all needed signalling channels and perform QKD via a single optical fiber over a distance of 25km.

articleTitle: Optical Networks: The Road Ahead
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Progress on research and development in optical networks will be discussed in this talk. Some emerging important topics include hybrid optical-wireless access, long-reach broadband access, dynamic optical circuit switching, robust network design, Ethernet everywhere, etc.

articleTitle: Combined Impact of Raman and EDFA Transients on Long Haul Transmission System Performance
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The combined impact of SRS and EDFA transients stemming from channel load changes is investigated. It is shown that the maximal power excursion deviates from the linear product of isolated SRS and amplifier gain transients.

articleTitle: Variable-Bit-Rate, Continuously-Controllable Optical TDM using SBS-Based Slow Light Tunable Delay Line
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate continuously-tunable OTDM using SBS-based slow-light. Two 75-ps misaligned 2.5-Gb/s RZ channels are successfully multiplexed, resulting in 9-dB power-penalty reduction.. Variable-bit-rate OTDM is demonstrated at three different bit-rates, all with error-free operation.

articleTitle: Ytterbium-doped 2D Solid Core Photonic Bandgap fiber for laser operation at 980 nm
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report on the fabrication and characterization of an ytterbium-doped Solid Core Photonic Bandgap Fiber. The bandgap losses introduced on the wavelength range above 1000 nm are used to favour laser gain at 977 nm.

articleTitle: Reflective ONUs by integration of Erbium Doped Waveguide Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and discuss using erbium-doped-waveguide amplifier as gain element in ONT. We demonstrate that it can provide high gain, bidirectional operation and bit-rate transparency paving the way to 10Gbps symmetric PON

articleTitle: Cost Reduction and Traffic Performance Improvement using Direct Forward Optical Layer Multicast in Optical Label Switching Nodes
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a simpler, faster, more efficient and economical multicast concept for passive waveguidebased optical label switching nodes. We analyze its advantages in terms of cost and traffic performance in comparison with the recirculation approach.

articleTitle: Achieving Physical Layer Security / Privacy with Self-Wrapped OCDM Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present a novel transmission system using self-wrapped WHTS OCDM signals to achieve enhanced transmission security. Distributed key is encoded and time-spread to hide under noise in the network. BER of 10-4 is demonstrated experimentally.

articleTitle: Optical Networks for Broadband Fixed and Mobile Services
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Optical network technologies from access to core for fixed and mobile broadband services are presented. Network management for multi-layer networks, resource management, and 100Gbit/s transport technologies for advanced high-quality network services are also presented.

articleTitle: Transmission of Upstream Data and Broadcast Signals over a Single Wavelength in WDM-PON Using Light-Injected Optical Sources
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and demonstrate the transmission of 122-Mb/s upstream data and broadcast signals over a single wavelength using mutually injection-locked FabryPerot laser diodes (MIL-FPLDs) and a reflective semiconductor optical amplifier (RSOA). To avoid the detrimental effect of periodic noise peaks of MIL-FPLD, we set the bit-rate of upstream data to the noise peak frequency and operate the RSOA in the gain-saturation region.

articleTitle: Dynamic control domains to achieve power stability in optically transparent mesh networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Simulation results show that the dynamic control domains method for scheduling network control events minimizes the interactions between channel power adjustments while simultaneously enabling multiple concurrent control adjustments in optically transparent mesh networks.

articleTitle: PMD Mitigation for 42 x 43 Gb/s DPSK (NRZ and RZ) by Distributed Polarisation Scrambling over 4820 km long NZDSF Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Simultaneous mitigation of 8ps mean DGD at 43Gb/s is demonstrated over 42 channels by use of 5 polarisation scramblers distributed over 4820km NZDSF straight line and UFEC with system margin. DPSK-NRZ and -RZ modulation performance is compared.

articleTitle: Temporal-Domain Diversity Reception with Improved Link Reliability for Optical Wireless Access Networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a simple temporal-domain diversity reception scheme to enhance the reliability of optical wireless transmission links with atmospheric turbulence effects. Link outage probability for a 1.25-Gb/s link using Manchester encoding is reduced by >96%.

articleTitle: Economics of Optical Control Plane Technology
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A flexible model was developed to analyze the economic impact of control plane technology on Next Generation Optical Transport Network deployment. Initial economic assessment suggests that substantial revenue realization gains and operation cost savings can be expected as a result of simplification of operation and circuit provisioning processes.

articleTitle: Fiber Fuse Effect: New Results on the Fiber Damage Structure
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Interference of the fiber modes in the process of optical discharge propagation along the fiber enables one to influence the parameters of the process and to produce sequences of bubbles with a period of ~10-1000micrometer.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of an Optical Interconnection Network with Asynchronous Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Asynchronous routing of optical packets experimentally demonstrated on a 44 3-stage interconnection network testbed, offering increased flexibility and efficiency. 610 Gb/s wavelength-striped packets with optically encoded addresses routed correctly. Error-free transmission is verified.

articleTitle: Holographic Tailoring of Launch Profile for Modal Selection in a 50micrometer Core Diameter Multi-Mode Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A spatial light modulator with a closed-loop iterative algorithm is demonstrated to be capable of performing modal control in a multimode fibre, generating a beam-size reduction and expansion of 30% and 100% in full-width half-maximum.

articleTitle: Extremely high reliability of guardring-free InAlAs avalanche photodiode
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The InAlAs avalanche photodiode with a guardring-free structure that reduces the bias voltage of the pn-junction of top surface exhibits a record high reliability of over 8000 hours at a high temperature of 200 oC.

articleTitle: A PON System Providing Triple Play Service Based on a Single Dual-Parallel Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel PON system providing triple play service with centralized light source using a single dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator. Upstream data re-modulation based on downstream DPSK format is also achieved.

articleTitle: 640 Gbit/s DWDM Transmission Over PCF Using Orthogonal Polarisation Channel Allocation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Negligible input polarisation state dependence is experimentally confirmed in PCF transmission. 40 Gbit/s 16 DWDM transmission over a 26 km long PCF is demonstrated using an orthogonal polarisation channel allocation for the first time.

articleTitle: Demonstration of FTTx System with QPSK Offset Sideband Modulation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: To alleviate the implications of bi-directional crosstalk in a simple in-line transceiver, 2.5 GSym/s QPSK offset sideband modulation and 1.25 Gb/s direct OOK modulation are used for downstream and upstream signalling, respectively.

articleTitle: Thin Film InGaAs/InAlAs Photodetectors Integrated on a Silicon-on- Insulator Waveguide Substrate
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We present compact and efficient InGaAs/InAlAs metal-semiconductor-metal photodetectors coupled with Silicon-on-Insulator waveguides. The responsivity of 25micrometer long detectors is 1.0A/W at a wavelength of 1.55micrometer. The dark current is 3.0nA at 5V bias.

articleTitle: Free-Space Optical Communication in a Swarm of Microrobots
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: This paper presents the theoretical investigations, supported by experimental measurements, of the communication channel between miniaturized optical communication systems to be integrated into swarming microrobots, while trying to stress very low power consumption issues.

articleTitle: 3Gbps-per-Channel Highly-Parallel Silicon Receiver OEIC
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An optoelectronic integrated circuit in 0.6micrometer BiCMOS containing 36 parallel receiver channels each with PIN photodiode and low-power amplifiers inclusive output drivers is presented. The sensitivity is -17.8dBm at 3Gbps in each channel for 850nm.

articleTitle: Indirect technique of measuring Raman gain efficiency distribution based on OTDR
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: An indirect technique is proposed for measuring Raman gain efficiency distribution by using OTDR. Raman gain efficiency is estimated easily from the relative-index difference and MFD, which can be measured by the bidirectional OTDR method.

articleTitle: A 160Gb/s to 10Gb/s DEMUX operation by Mach-Zehnder Interferometric Intersubband Ultrafast All-Optical Switch
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Mach-Zehnder interferometric ultrafast optical switching module utilizing novel TE cross-phase modulation caused by TM intersubband excitation in InGaAs/AlAs/AlAsSb coupled quantum wells was fabricated. A 160Gb/s to10Gb/s DEMUX operation was demonstrated.

articleTitle: FROG Characterisation of a Turbo-Switch Wavelength Converter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The FROG technique is used to characterise output pulses from a Turbo-Switch wavelength converter in different configurations. Results show low chip on the output pulses, a vital requirement in high-speed optical transmission systems.

articleTitle: Enabling Services in Broadband Access
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The paper describes functions to enable services over a broadband access network. A service plane is introduced to embed such functions in the access network. Examples for multimedia delivery are given.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Use of Electronic Pre-Distortion and MLSE Equalization in Long-Haul Transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: The performance of an 11Gbit/s NRZ transmission system over 1600km utilizing electronic predistortion coupled with 2sample/bit 32-state MLSE equalization is studied. We show that MLSE reduces the OSNR penalty in the linear and nonlinear regime.

articleTitle: Chromatic-Dispersion-Insensitive PMD Monitoring of 20-Gb/s DQPSK and 10-Gb/s DPSK Using DGD-Generated Polarization-Based Interferometer Filter
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a chromatic dispersion insensitive PMD monitoring technique using a polarization-based interferometer filter for phase-shift-keyed transmission systems. This technique can monitor 0-100ps of DGD, insensitive to 0-650 ps/nm chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Passband-expandable tunable filter for optical network aggregation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We demonstrate wavelength and bandwidth tunable optical filters with box-like passband shape. The wavelength tuning range is 40 nm and the 3dB-bandwidth varies from 0.2 nm to 6.0 nm. The filter shape factor defined as the ratio between 3dB- and 20dB-bandwidth reaches over 0.9.

articleTitle: Comparison on Crosstalk Tolerance of RZ-DPSK and RZ-OOK Modulation Format in Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigated crosstalk tolerance of RZ-DPSK and RZ-OOK modulation format in OPA with 100GHz channel spacing. Results show an average of 2.4dB improvement in Q factor by using RZ-DPSK format over RZOOK format.

articleTitle: 1-square-inch 100GHz 40ch VMUX/DEMUX based on single-chip PLC integration with 2.5%-Delta silica-based waveguides
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We developed a 1-square-inch 100GHz 40ch VMUX/DEMUX based on single-chip PLC integration and stacked PD integration techniques. The use of 2.5%-Delta silica-based waveguides greatly reduced the chip size without degrading optical performance.

articleTitle: Dual-Mode Fibre (DMF) capable of single- and multi-mode transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Single- and multimode optical signal transmission with DMF was demonstrated for the first time. This DMF also has a relatively low bending optical loss for simultaneous single- and multi-mode transmission.

articleTitle: Low-drive-voltage and compact RZ-DQPSK LiNbO3 Modulator
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Integrated RZ-DQPSK modulator was for the first time developed with small bend radius and low-loss U-turn optical waveguide. It achieved low-drive-voltage: 3.5V for DQPSK modulator and 1.5V for RZ pulse carver.

articleTitle: Experimental Synchronization Monitoring of I/Q Misalignment and Pulse Carving Misalignment in 20-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK Data Generation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the misalignment monitoring of I/Q data streams and carver misalignment in a 20-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK transmitter. We get 20dB dynamic range for data misalignment and 6.3dB dynamic range for carver misalignment by measuring RF clock-tone and low-frequency power.

articleTitle: Low-Cost Non-intrusive Fiber Monitoring in a PON Last Drop
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Low-cost embedded negative step response OTDR performs PON last drop fiber plant monitoring from an ONU without need for additional optical components, without penalty on network link performance and without service interrupt.

articleTitle: Low chirp QPSK modulator integrated in poled Z-cut LiNbO3 substrate for 2 x MultiGb/s transmission
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We report a new QPSK modulator realized in Zcut lithium niobate crystal. The chirp is cancelled out by ferroelectric domain inversion. The halfwave voltage of 4.7V is 1V smaller than the one of Xcut modulators.

articleTitle: Dispersion Map Suitable for Hybrid 10 Gb/s NRZ and 40 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Transmission over 50 GHz-Spaced Network with Low Dispersion Fibre
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We propose a dispersion compensation strategy that enables smooth migration from low-initial cost (with 10Gb/s NRZ) to high ultimate capacity (with 40Gb/s RZ-DQPSK) for 50 GHz-spaced photonic networks, and demonstrate transmission reach beyond 1350 km.

articleTitle: Physical layer impairment (PLI)-aware routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) in dispersion-managed DWDM networks
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A PLI-aware RWA algorithm with unique workflow is proposed for provisioning and rerouting in GMPLSenabled transparent DWDM networks. Although fiber nonlinearities in dispersion-managed systems are captured, standard performance assessment is outpaced by orders of magnitude.

articleTitle: Feedback effects on performance of DM and DFB lasers in RoF systems
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Impact of optical feedback on performance of Discrete-Mode and DFB lasers used as transmitters in RoF system is investigated. Results show that the DM laser is capable of handling 10dB more feedback than DFB laser.

articleTitle: Optimal Design for Coherent Optical OFDM Transmitter Employing Pre-distortion
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A detailed analysis is presented on the optimal design for coherent optical OFDM transmitter employing predistortion. The optimal design shows 4-bit DAC resolution is sufficient and the excess loss for optical IQ modulator is 5.0 dB.

articleTitle: 40Gb/s Distortion Mitigation and DSP-Based Equalisat
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: Different aspects of electronic distortion equalization at 40Gbit/s are highlighted: from the experimental assessment of analog equalizer circuits to the estimation of the digital processing effort in DSP based equalisation schemes.

articleTitle: Impact of WDM Channel Dynamics on Transmission Performance of 42.7-Gb/s DBPSK and DQPSK
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: We investigate the impact of WDM channel dynamics on the performance of 42.7-Gb/s DBPSK and DQPSK signals in a transparent optical link, and show their robustness against rapid and large power changes in other channels.

articleTitle: 160 Gbit/s-900 km DPSK Transmission with Time-domain Optical Fourier Transformation
publicationTitle: 33rd European Conference and Exhibition of Optical Communication
abstract: A straight-line 160 Gbit/s-900 km DPSK transmission was successfully demonstrated with time-domain optical Fourier transformation without employing polarization multiplexing or Raman amplification. The transmission performance was almost ASE limited due to in-line EDFAs.
